text: 此世并无幸福可言。
en: There is no happiness in this world.

text: 只要主公一声令下，无论是讨伐他国大名，还是诛杀落魄浪人，理由根本无关紧要——这就是武士。
en: If our lord so orders, we cut down other lords' men or masterless samurai alike. The reason does not matter. That is what it means to be a samurai.

text: 十三人对两百人——五五开吧。
这场战争只有一种结束方式：谁活到最后，谁赢。
en: There's only one way this war ends. Last man standing.

text: 厂没有了，记忆还在。
en: The factory is gone; the memory remains.

text: 追求卓越，成功就会在不经意间追上你。
en: Pursue excellence, and success will come chasing after you.

text: 一切顺利。
en: All is well.

text: 心很脆弱，你要学会哄它。不管遇到多大的问题，就告诉你的心：「一切顺利，朋友。」
en: This heart scares easily. You have to trick it. However big the problem, tell your heart, 'All is well, pal.'

text: 凡是能帮人省力、帮人省时的东西，就是机器。
en: Anything that simplifies work, or saves time, is a machine.

text: 樱花飘落的速度，是秒速五厘米。
en: Cherry blossoms fall at five centimeters per second.

text: 我只是试着把每一天，都过成自己精心选择的日子。
en: I just try to live every day as if I've deliberately chosen it as the day I wanted to live.

text: 我们每天都在一起穿越时间。我们所能做的，就是尽力享受这段奇妙的旅程。
en: We're all traveling through time together, every day of our lives. All we can do is do our best to relish this remarkable ride.

text: 罗马郊外的光，照得见贫穷，照不见出路。
en: Light on the outskirts of Rome shows poverty — not a way out.

text: 新闻要的不是救人，是把洞挖得够深。
en: What the news wants is not a rescue — it is a hole dug deep enough.

text: 大新闻小新闻我都能对付——要是没新闻，我就出去咬条狗回来。
en: I can handle big news and little news. And if there's no news, I'll go out and bite a dog.

text: 请从一生中选出一段最宝贵的回忆——你将只带着它前往天国。
en: Choose one most precious memory from your life; you will take only that into eternity.

text: 不是每个人，都能成为自己理想中的大人。
en: Not everyone gets to become the adult they imagined.

text: 不必非得幸福。要是幸福以外的东西，也让你觉得幸福，就够了。
不中彩票，日子就过不下去啦。
我是上帝的愤怒。
en: I am the wrath of God.

text: 他生平第一次，去了梦开始的地方。
en: And for the first time in his life, he went to that place where dreams are born.

text: 我存在。我曾存在。
en: I am. I was.

text: 请把我变成真的。请让我成为一个真正的男孩。
en: Please make me real. Please make me a real boy.

text: 阿基拉的力量正在觉醒。
en: Akira’s power is awakening.

text: 整个神灯差事的一部分：惊天动地的宇宙神力！巴掌大的住的地方！
en: Phenomenal cosmic powers! Itty-bitty living space!

text: 规矩一：我不能杀人，所以别问。规矩二：我不能让人爱上别人。
en: Rule number one: I can't kill anybody. So don't ask. Rule two: I can't make anyone fall in love with anybody else.

text: 你相信我吗？
en: Do you trust me?

text: 巷战教给你的，不是胜利，是谁先学会害怕。
en: Street war teaches you not victory — but who learns to fear first.

text: 恐惧吞噬灵魂。
en: Fear eats the soul.

text: 我想知道，做一个孩子是什么感觉。
en: I want to know what it feels like to be a child.

text: 我欣赏它的纯粹。一个幸存者——不被良心、悔恨或道德幻觉所遮蔽。
en: I admire its purity. A survivor... unclouded by conscience, remorse, or delusions of morality.

text: 你还是不明白自己在对付什么，对吧？完美的有机体。它结构之完美，只有它的敌意能与之相称。
en: You still don't understand what you're dealing with, do you? A perfect organism. Its structural perfection is matched only by its hostility.

text: 关于你们的胜算，我无法对你撒谎。不过——我深表同情。
en: I can't lie to you about your chances, but... you have my sympathies.

text: 这里是雷普利，诺斯托罗莫号最后的幸存者，结束记录。
en: This is Ripley, last survivor of the Nostromo, signing off.

text: 离她远点，你这该死的东西！
en: Get away from her, you bitch!

text: 结束了，伙计们！全完了！
en: Game over, man! Game over!

text: 我的意见是：直接撤走，然后从轨道上把整个地方核平。这是唯一稳妥的办法。
en: I say we take off and nuke the entire site from orbit. It's the only way to be sure.

text: 它们通常在夜里来。通常。
en: They mostly come at night. Mostly.

text: 妈妈总说世上没有怪物，没有真的怪物。可是有。
en: My mommy always said there were no monsters — no real ones — but there are.

text: 系好安全带——前面要颠簸了。
en: Fasten your seatbelts. It’s going to be a bumpy night.

text: 女人的行当，处处都是滑头生意。
en: Funny business, a woman's life.

text: 你可以比你想象的更真实。
en: You can be more authentic than you imagine.

text: 我爱你。
en: Je vous aime. / I love you.

text: 太多音符了。
en: Too many notes.

text: 我代表世上所有的平庸之辈。我是他们的代言人，他们的守护圣人。
en: I speak for all mediocrities in the world. I am their champion. I am their patron saint.

text: 平庸之辈们……我赦免你们。
en: Mediocrities everywhere... I absolve you.

text: 从今起，你我即为仇敌——因为你选中的器皿，是一个自负、好色、下流、幼稚的男孩；而你，不公。
en: From now on, we are enemies, You and I. Because You choose for Your instrument a boastful, lustful, smutty, infantile boy... and because You are unjust.

text: 小镇记得春天、法西斯和每个人的笑话。
en: The town remembers spring, fascism, and everybody's jokes.

text: 对做梦的人来说，日子总是艰难。
en: Times are hard for dreamers.

text: 老了以后，你会发现，即使是你最在意的往事，有时也会想不起来。
en: All I see is a boy, with a curious look…

text: 我喜欢街上的气味，闻着让我踏实。
en: I like the stink of the streets. They make me feel good.

text: 被朋友出卖的时候，就得还手。
en: When you've been betrayed by a friend, you hit back.

text: 有时候这世界美得让人受不了——我感觉心要倾出来了。
en: Sometimes there's so much beauty in the world, I feel like I can't take it... and my heart is just going to cave in.

text: 这不是生活。这只是一堆东西——它们变得比生活本身还重要。
en: This isn't life. This is just stuff. And it's become more important to you than living.

text: 我只是个一无所有的普通人。
en: I'm just an ordinary guy with nothing to lose.

text: 我今天就要把这栋房子卖掉。
en: I will sell this house today.

text: 你以为仇恨让你更强，其实仇恨是一种负担。人生苦短，没必要一直带着怒火活着。
en: Hate is baggage. Life’s too short to be pissed off all the time. It’s just not worth it.

text: 你做过的那些事，有哪一件让你的日子变好了吗？
en: Has anything you've done made your life better?

text: 爱是一只狗。
en: Love is a bitch. / Amores perros.

text: 午后的诱惑最危险——理智还醒着，心却开始走神。
en: Afternoon temptation is the most dangerous — reason is still awake while the heart drifts.

text: 事情还会像以前一样继续下去。
en: Things will go on as they have done up until now.

text: 人到底是什么？
en: What, after all, is a man?

text: 还有明天。
en: There's still tomorrow.

text: 我们大多数人都活在一种悬置的动画状态里。
en: Most of us live in a state of suspended animation.

text: 她们穿白衣，可没人把她们当天使。
en: They wear white — but no one treats them as angels.

text: 偏见，总会模糊真相。
en: Prejudice always obscures the truth.

text: 不经讨论就举手把一个孩子送上电椅，没那么容易。
en: It's not easy to raise my hand and send a boy off to die without talking about it first.

text: 你不会真的想杀了我吧？
en: You don't really mean you'll kill me, do you?

text: 我们需要那些蛋。
en: I guess we need the eggs.

text: 感情就像鲨鱼——必须不停地向前游，不然就死。
en: A relationship, I think, is like a shark. It has to constantly move forward or it dies.

text: 啦嘀嗒，啦嘀嗒。
en: La-dee-da, la-dee-da.

text: 我想去加尔各答。
en: I want to go to Calcutta.

text: 闭嘴，发牌。
en: Shut up and deal.

text: 跟已婚男人谈恋爱，就不该化睫毛膏。
en: When you're in love with a married man, you shouldn't wear mascara.

text: 饼干就是这样碎的。
en: That's the way it crumbles... cookie-wise.

text: 你们这些疯子！你们把它炸掉了！该死！你们都该死！
en: You Maniacs! You blew it up! God damn you! God damn you all to hell!

text: 把你那臭烘烘的爪子从我身上拿开，你这该死的脏猩猩！
en: Get your stinking paws off me, you damned dirty ape!

text: 人学人样。
en: Human see, human do.

text: 我喜欢硝烟在早晨的味道。
en: I love the smell of napalm in the morning.

text: 查理不冲浪！
en: Charlie don't surf!

text: 恐怖。恐怖啊。
en: The horror. The horror.

text: 西贡……我还在西贡。
en: Saigon... I'm still only in Saigon.

text: 四月的某几天，兄弟也能被广播分成两边。
en: In a few days of April, even brothers can be split by a radio broadcast.

text: 四月的风，把人吹到东京。
en: An April wind blows a person all the way to Tokyo.

text: 学长……我一直很喜欢你。
地下活动的第一课：连呼吸都要学会隐瞒。
en: First lesson of the underground: even breathing must learn to hide.

text: 我叫阿莉埃蒂。我是个借东西的小人。
en: I'm Arrietty. I'm a borrower.

text: 语言是文明的基础，也是冲突中拔出的第一件武器。
en: Language is the foundation of civilization. It is the first weapon drawn in a conflict.

text: 如果能从头到尾看见你的一生，你还会改变它吗？
en: If you could see your whole life from start to finish, would you change things?

text: 即使知道旅程和它的终点，我也拥抱它，迎接它的每一个瞬间。
en: Despite knowing the journey and where it leads, I embrace it, and welcome every moment of it.

text: 我不会背叛任何人。
en: I will not betray anyone.

text: 咱们是哪种人？咱们是江湖上的人。
en: What kind of people are we? People of the jianghu.

text: 明天，我们就会消失。
en: Tomorrow, we will be gone.

text: 当你不能够再拥有，你唯一可以做的，就是令自己不要忘记。
en: When you can no longer possess something, the only thing you can do is make sure you never forget.

text: 很多年之后，我有了个绰号叫西毒。其实任何人都可以变得狠毒，只要你尝试过什么叫嫉妒。
人最大的烦恼，就是记性太好。如果什么都可以忘掉，以后的每一天都会是一个新的开始，那你说多开心。
以前我认为那句话很重要，因为我总觉得有些话说出来就是一生一世。现在想一想，其实说不说也没有分别。有些事，是会变的。
为了一个鸡蛋而失去一根手指，值得吗？不值得！但我觉得痛快，这才是我自己。
暗杀名单上的人，未必比执行的人更知道自己为何而战。
en: Those on the assassination list may know no better than the killers why they are fighting.

text: 国家是什么？国家就是国民！
en: What is a nation? A nation is its people!

text: 按常识来说——
再往深处，痛才会变成爱。
en: Only deeper does pain turn into love.

text: 一个人生活，也不坏。
en: Living alone is not so bad.

text: 我必须学会生活。我每天都在练习。
en: I must learn to live. I practise every day.

text: 在纽约，没有船头尺，你会更难。
en: In New York, without someone like me, it would be harder for you.

text: 我看见你了。
en: I see you.

text: 你不在堪萨斯了——你到了潘多拉。
en: You're not in Kansas anymore. You are on Pandora.

text: 这就是我的秘密，队长。我一直都很愤怒。
en: That's my secret, Captain. I'm always angry.

text: 我是阿斯加德的洛基，我肩负着光荣的使命。
en: I am Loki, of Asgard, and I am burdened with glorious purpose.

text: 天才，亿万富翁，花花公子，慈善家。
en: Genius, billionaire, playboy, philanthropist.

text: 我有大军。
en: I have an army.

text: 我们有浩克。
en: We have a Hulk.

text: 她失踪以后，留下的不是线索，是彼此之间忽然空出来的距离。
en: After she vanished, what remained was not a clue — but a sudden distance between them.

text: 就算在最黑暗的时候，也能找到幸福——只要记得打开灯。
en: Happiness can be found even in the darkest of times, if one only remembers to turn on the light.

text: 那你真该死掉！死也不该背叛朋友！
en: Then you should have died! Died, rather than betray your friends!

text: 儿子，有些错，一辈子也还不完。
en: Some mistakes, my son, can never be repaid.

text: 去哪儿都行。某个地方。随便哪儿。
en: Anywhere. Somewhere. Wherever.

text: 背靠着权力，脸对着人情——两头都要活。
en: Back against power, face to favor—you have to live on both sides.

text: 故事一改，记忆也会跟着说谎。
en: Change the story, and memory starts to lie with it.

text: 我不死，我要活！我要报仇，我要活！
en: I will not die—I will live! I will take revenge—I will live!

text: 牲口不懂得宽恕，却比人更早学会了承受。
en: A beast does not know forgiveness, yet learns to bear more sooner than men.

text: 做女人几乎是不可能的。你这么美、这么聪明，可你仍觉得自己不够好——这快把我逼疯了。
en: It is literally impossible to be a woman. You are so beautiful, and so smart, and it kills me that you don't think you're good enough.

text: 人类只有一个结局，而理念可以永远活下去。
en: Humans only have one ending. Ideas live forever.

text: 而且——我也已经足够了。
en: And I'm enough!

text: 你真美。
en: You're so beautiful.

text: 在乔治三世统治时期，这个人物活着并发迹。
en: It was in the reign of George III that the aforementioned person lived and prospered.

text: 尤蒂维奇，我觉得这大概是我的杰作。
en: You know somethin', Utivich? I think this just might be my masterpiece.

text: 哦哦——宾果！
en: Oooh, that's a bingo!

text: 我们不做俘虏生意——我们做的是杀纳粹的买卖。
en: We ain't in the prisoner-takin' business. We in the killin' Nazi business.

text: 生活是个婊子，现在，我也是！
en: Life's a bitch, now so am I!

text: 你只是嫉妒——我是天生的怪物，你却得靠面具！
en: You're just jealous because I'm a genuine freak and you have to wear a mask!

text: 我们为什么会跌倒？这样我们才能学会重新站起来。
en: Why do we fall, Bruce? So we can learn to pick ourselves up.

text: 舞台感与欺骗，是强大的武器。
en: Theatricality and deception are powerful agents.

text: 定义我的，不是面具下的我是谁——而是我做的事。
en: It's not who I am underneath, but what I do that defines me.

text: 要征服恐惧，你必须成为恐惧本身。
en: To conquer fear, you must become fear.

text: 我是大白，你的个人健康顾问。
en: I am Baymax, your personal healthcare companion.

text: 在你对护理服务表示满意之前，我无法进入待机状态。
en: I cannot deactivate until you say you are satisfied with your care.

text: 阿正还在。
en: Tadashi is here.

text: 拳头学会的节奏，钢琴未必肯认。
en: The rhythm the fists learned, the piano may refuse to acknowledge.

text: 或许，自由始于悔恨。
en: Maybe freedom begins with remorse.

text: 我不知道这一切会如何收场。我想我会等着。等什么？我不知道。
en: I don't know how it will end. I think I'll wait. Wait for what? I don't know.

text: 你是我活下去的全部理由。
en: You are the reason I am. You are all my reasons.

text: 我一直相信数字、方程和逻辑可以指引我们理性……但只有在爱的神秘等式里，才能找到任何逻辑或理由。
en: I've always believed in numbers... It is only in the mysterious equations of love that any logic or reasons can be found.

text: 我还是会看见那些不存在的东西。只是我选择不去理会。
en: I still see things that are not here. I just choose not to acknowledge them.

text: 真正的美，是心灵的美。
en: True beauty is found within.

text: 我们可以把一切说清楚——或者就这样一起老去。
en: We can say everything out loud—or grow old together anyway.

text: 如果你今晚做梦，请梦到我。
en: If you dream tonight, dream of me.

text: 世上若真有魔法，一定藏在试图理解一个人、分享一些什么的过程里。
en: If there's any kind of magic in this world, it must be in the attempt of understanding someone, sharing something.

text: 我们做的一切，不都是想多被爱一点点吗？
en: Isn't everything we do in life a way to be loved a little more?

text: 宝贝，你要误机了。
en: Baby, you are gonna miss that plane.

text: 记忆是件美妙的东西——如果你不必和过去打交道的话。
en: Memory is a wonderful thing if you don't have to deal with the past.

text: 在读你那本破书之前，我本来好好的。
en: I was fine. Until I read your fucking book. It stirred shit up...

text: 我喜欢看。
en: I like to watch.

text: 只要根没有断，一切都会好起来。
en: As long as the roots are not severed, all is well.

text: 在花园里，生长有季节。
en: In a garden, growth has its season.

text: 他们要的不是孩子，是能卖钱的脸。
en: They don't want a child — they want a face that sells.

text: 你眼里满是仇恨，犹大。很好。仇恨能让人活下去——它给人力量。
en: Your eyes are full of hate, Judah. That's good. Hate keeps a man alive. It gives him strength.

text: 让你们活着，就是为了给这艘船划桨——好好划，好好活。
en: We keep you alive to serve this ship. So row well, and live.

text: 我希望你过上令自己自豪的生活。若发现并非如此，希望你有力量重新开始。
en: I hope you live a life you're proud of. If you find that you're not, I hope you have the strength to start all over again.

text: 有些人天生坐在河边。有些人遭雷劈。有些人精通音律……而有些人——生来就跳舞。
en: Some people were born to sit by a river. Some get struck by lightning. Some have an ear for music... And some people — dance.

text: 晚安，黛西。
en: Goodnight, Daisy.

text: 没有什么地方比得上家。
en: There’s no place like home.

text: 我路过。
en: I was just passing by.

text: 我等了三年，就是要等一个机会。我要争一口气——不是想证明我了不起，我是要告诉人家：我失去的东西，一定要拿回来！
一个人不能失去自己的尊严。
en: A man cannot lose his dignity.

text: 一个人把他的故事讲了太多次，他就变成了那些故事。故事在他死后继续活着，他也因此不朽。
en: A man tells his stories so many times that he becomes the stories. They live on after him, and in that way he becomes immortal.

text: 人们说，当你遇见一生的挚爱时，时间会停住——这是真的。
en: They say when you meet the love of your life, time stops, and that's true.

text: 愤怒只会生出更多愤怒。
en: Anger begets greater anger.

text: 舞台上的飞，往往是为了不看见台下的坠落。
en: Flying on stage is often a way not to see the fall below.

text: 人气，是声望那个浪荡的表妹。
en: Popularity is the slutty little cousin of prestige.

text: 丢的只是一枚棋子。
en: It was only a chess piece that was lost.

text: 我以后再也不下棋了。
想逃，逃不掉。
en: Want to run — you can’t.

text: 我不是来这里做奴隶的。
en: I did not come here to be your slave.

text: 这一切都在你的脑子里。
en: It’s all in your mind.

text: 瓦坎达永存！
en: Wakanda forever!

text: 危机之中，智者修桥，愚者筑墙。
en: In times of crisis, the wise build bridges while the foolish build barriers.

text: 把我葬进海里，和那些跳船的祖先在一起——他们知道，死亡好过枷锁。
en: Bury me in the ocean, with my ancestors that jumped from the ships, because they knew death was better than bondage.

text: 我们要学会彼此照看——像同一个部族。
en: We must find a way to look after one another, as if we were one single tribe.

text: 我……很完美。
en: I was perfect.

text: 完美不只是控制——还有放手。
en: Perfection is not just about control. It's also about letting go.

text: 美国优先！
en: America First!

text: 一切权力，归于全体人民！
en: All power to all the people!

text: 这些瞬间都会消逝在时间里，如同眼泪消失在雨中。
en: All those moments will be lost in time, like tears in rain.

text: 烧得两倍亮的灯——只能烧一半的时间。
en: The light that burns twice as bright burns half as long.

text: 你完成了一个男子汉的活儿，长官。
en: You've done a man's job, sir.

text: 有时我想，上帝会不会原谅我们对彼此做过的事？然后我环顾四周——才明白上帝早就离开了这地方。
en: Sometimes I wonder: will God ever forgive us for what we've done to each other? Then I look around and I realize—God left this place a long time ago.

text: T-I-A。这就是非洲。
en: TIA. This is Africa.

text: 我现在待的地方，就是我该待的地方。
en: I'm exactly where I'm supposed to be.

text: 这世上最脏的生意，往往做在最干净的佛堂里。
en: The dirtiest deals are often done in the cleanest temples.

text: 我是为你好。
一家人整整齐齐的，多好。
放大以后看见的，不一定是真相，更像是你愿意相信的空白。
en: What enlargement reveals is not necessarily truth — more like a blank you are willing to believe.

text: 脖子上的蓝色勒痕，是他们不肯看见的证据。
en: The blue mark on the neck is the evidence they refuse to see.

text: 这是一个奇怪的世界。
en: It’s a strange world.

text: 别看我！
en: Don't look at me!

text: 我不知道你到底是侦探还是变态。
en: I don't know if you're a detective or a pervert.

text: 初恋的蓝，会把整段青春染上颜色。
en: The blue of first love colors a whole youth.

text: 我想离开这里。
en: I want to leave this place.

text: 我不想做一支摇滚乐队——我想做那支摇滚乐队。
en: I don't want to be a rock band. I want to be THE rock band.

text: 我才不要当摇滚明星——我要当传奇。
en: I'm not going to be a rockstar. I'm going to be a legend!

text: 我们自己做选择，也自己付代价。
en: We make our own choices. We pay our own prices.

text: 我们啊，是最接近恋爱的朋友，也是最接近朋友的恋人。
en: We were the closest thing to lovers among friends—and the closest thing to friends among lovers.

text: 我们结婚吧。
en: Kekkon shiyou.

text: 晚宴永远开不了席——礼仪比饥饿更不肯让步。
en: Dinner never quite begins — etiquette yields less readily than hunger.

text: 我都想起来了。我全都想起来了。
en: I remember. I remember everything.

text: 好好休息吧，帕姆。你看起来累了。
en: Get some rest, Pam. You look tired.

text: 看看我们。看看他们逼你交出了什么。
en: Look at us. Look at what they make you give.

text: 巴黎的夜很长，刚好够两个陌生人走丢又相遇。
en: Paris nights are long enough for two strangers to get lost — and meet again.

text: 沉默等于死亡。行动起来。
en: Silence = Death. Act up.

text: 我是杀手，除此之外一无所有。
en: I am a killer; I have nothing else.

text: 他们也许能夺走我们的生命，但永远夺不走我们的自由！
en: They may take our lives, but they'll never take our freedom!

text: 每个人都会死，但不是每个人都真正活过。
en: Every man dies, not every man really lives.

text: 自由！！
en: FREEDOM!

text: 你的心是自由的。要有勇气，追随它。
en: Your heart is free. Have the courage to follow it.

text: 英格兰的史学家会说我在撒谎，但历史本就是由绞死英雄的人书写的。
en: Historians from England will say I am a liar, but history is written by those who have hanged heroes.

text: 我们都很古怪。只不过有些人更擅长掩饰罢了。
en: We're all pretty bizarre. Some of us are just better at hiding it, that's all.

text: 亲爱的弗农先生：我们接受这个事实——为了我们犯的错，牺牲整个周六留校察看。但我们觉得你疯了，居然要我们写文章告诉你，我们觉得自己是谁。
en: Dear Mr. Vernon, we accept the fact that we had to sacrifice a whole Saturday in detention for whatever it was we did wrong... but we think you're crazy to make us write an essay telling you who we think we are.

text: 螺丝松了很正常——世界本来就不完美。
en: Screws fall out all the time. The world's an imperfect place.

text: 我相信奇迹。
en: I believe in miracles.

text: 跑着的人最怕停下来——停下来就要承认自己在逃。
en: Those who keep running fear stopping most — to stop is to admit they are fleeing.

text: 真让人恶心。
en: C'est vraiment dégueulasse.

text: 你好。我叫伊尼戈·蒙托亚。你杀了我父亲。准备受死吧。
en: Hello. My name is Inigo Montoya. You killed my father. Prepare to die.

text: 你一直在用那个词——我不认为它是什么意思你就是什么意思。
en: You keep using that word. I do not think it means what you think it means.

text: 如你所愿。
en: As you wish.

text: 不可思议！
en: Inconceivable!

text: 我爱上了你。我并不想这样，但它发生了。
en: I have fallen in love with you. I didn’t mean to, but it happened.

text: 水母在毒药里也能发光，人却未必。
en: A jellyfish can glow even in poison — a person may not.

text: 我想要的，只是一点明亮的夏日。
en: All I want is a brighter summer day.

text: 我多希望我知道怎么戒掉你。
en: I wish I knew how to quit you.

text: 修不好，就得忍着。
en: If you can't fix it, you've got to stand it.

text: 告诉你，我们本可以一起过好日子的——他妈的真正的好日子！
en: Tell you what, we coulda had a good life together! Fuckin' real good life!

text: 杰克，我发誓——
en: Jack, I swear—

text: 弃婴被转手的路上，也可能拼出一家人。
en: On the road where abandoned babies change hands, a family can still be pieced together.

text: 谢谢你选择了我们。
我们要去的地方，不需要路。
en: Roads? Where we're going, we don't need roads.

text: 如果我的计算没错，这辆车开到时速八十八英里的时候——你们就要见到不得了的场面了。
en: If my calculations are correct, when this baby hits 88 miles per hour... you're gonna see some serious shit.

text: 谁也别叫我胆小鬼。
en: Nobody calls me chicken.

text: 喂喂喂，有人在家吗？动动脑子，麦克弗莱！
en: Hello? Hello? Anybody home? Think, McFly! Think!

text: 衡量自己的标准，是那些以你为标准的人。
en: You measure yourself by the people who measure themselves by you.

text: 我们生，我们死，公交车轮子转个不停。
en: We live, we die, and the wheels on the bus go round and round.

text: 在这曾被称为人性的野蛮屠场里，文明仍有微光。
en: There are still faint glimmers of civilization left in this barbaric slaughterhouse that was once known as humanity.

text: 生活里许多事无缘无故地发生。我们挑出几件，连成一条思路，就称之为理由。
en: Random things happen for no reason in our lives. We choose a few and form a line of thought made by all these dots, which we call a reason.

text: 我们还能做朋友吗？
en: Can we still be friends?

text: 站着把钱挣了。
en: Earn the money while standing tall.

text: 枪在手，跟我走！杀四郎，抢碉楼！
我来鹅城只办三件事：公平！公平！还是他妈的公平！
彼时彼刻？——恰如此时此刻。
有一种饥饿，再怎么吃也填不满。
en: There is a hunger that no amount of eating can fill.

text: 我烧塑料大棚……那是我的爱好。
有一天这一切都会结束。
en: One day all of this will end.

text: 到了釜山，就会安全了。
en: Once we reach Busan, we'll be safe.

text: 我妻子的名字，叫盛京。
谁是这些人？
en: Who are those guys?

text: 太漂亮了，老是被抢。
en: People kept robbing it.

text: 继续想吧，布奇——你就擅长这个。
en: You just keep thinkin', Butch. That's what you're good at.

text: 你改动过去的一点点，就会改写整个未来。
en: Change one thing, change everything.

text: 童年开始学的单词，有一天会被战争改写发音。
en: The words a child first learns may one day have their pronunciation rewritten by war.

text: 被人骗光之后，还可以对自己笑一次。
en: After being cheated of everything, you can still smile once — for yourself.

text: 我不是疯子，我只是想被爱。
en: I am not crazy; I only want to be loved.

text: 你必须成为卡里加里！
en: You must become Caligari!

text: 我想起诉我的父母。
en: I want to sue my parents.

text: 因为他们生下了我。
en: Because they gave birth to me.

text: 来日方长，孩子。
en: Here's looking at you, kid.

text: 我们永远拥有巴黎。
en: We'll always have Paris.

text: 世界上有那么多城镇，城镇里有那么多酒馆，她偏偏走进了我这家。
en: Of all the gin joints in all the towns in all the world, she walks into mine.

text: 照老规矩，抓几个惯犯。
en: Round up the usual suspects.

text: 路易斯，我想这是一段美好友谊的开始。
en: Louis, I think this is the beginning of a beautiful friendship.

text: 我征服的不是女人，是她们愿意被征服的幻想。
en: I do not conquer women — I conquer the fantasy that they wish to be conquered.

text: 赌场生意的首要规则，就是让他们继续玩，让他们不断回来。
en: In the casino business, the cardinal rule is to keep them playing and to keep them coming back.

text: 爱一个人，就得信任他。没有别的办法。
en: When you love someone, you've gotta trust them. There's no other way.

text: 金盔再亮，也护不住一场注定见血的爱情。
en: However bright the golden casque, it cannot shield a love already destined for blood.

text: 我必须继续呼吸。因为明天太阳还会升起。谁知道潮水会带来什么呢？
en: I have to keep breathing. Because tomorrow the sun will rise. Who knows what the tide could bring?

text: 威尔逊！
en: Wilson!

text: 我连按自己想要的方式死掉都做不到。
en: I couldn't even kill myself the way I wanted to. I had power over nothing.

text: 两只小老鼠掉进奶油桶：一只放弃淹死了；另一只拼命搅打，把奶油搅成黄油，然后爬了出来。
en: Two little mice fell in a bucket of cream. The first mouse quickly gave up and drowned. The second mouse wouldn't quit... He churned that cream into butter and crawled out.

text: 如果我们燃烧，你们也要一起烧！
en: If we burn, you burn with us!

text: 真希望把此刻定格，就永远活在这里面。
en: I wish I could freeze this moment, right here, right now, and live in it forever.

text: 我害怕有一天，你也会把我忘掉。
en: I'm afraid that one day you'll forget me too.

text: 我还想再唱一次。
en: I want to sing one more time.

text: 决定我们成为什么人的，不是我们的能力，而是我们的选择。
en: It is our choices, Harry, that show what we truly are, far more than our abilities.

text: 多比没有主人。多比是个自由的小精灵！
en: Dobby has no master. Dobby is a free elf!

text: 我很孤独。
en: I am lonely.

text: 雨停了，颜色还在——分别却比彩虹更长久。
en: When the rain stops, the colors remain — but parting lasts longer than any rainbow.

text: 姐姐，这双鞋给你。
en: Sister, these shoes are for you.

text: 婴儿是唯一重要的事。
en: The baby is all that matters.

text: 没有嫉妒，就没有爱情。
en: There is no love without jealousy.

text: 我不认识你，老头。
en: I know thee not, old man.

text: 放逐了胖子杰克，就是放逐了整个世界。
en: Banish plump Jack, and banish all the world.

text: 荣誉是什么？一句话而已。
en: What is honour? A word.

text: 算了吧，杰克。这儿是唐人街。
en: Forget it, Jake. It's Chinatown.

text: 大多数人从不必面对一个事实：在对的时间、对的地点，他们什么都干得出来。
en: Most men never have to face the fact that at the right time and the right place, they're capable of anything.

text: 你真是只多管闲事的小猫。
en: You're a very nosy fellow, kitty cat.

text: 永远别说永远，凡事都有可能。
en: Never say never — anything is possible.

text: 过节团聚，是把旧账和新病放在同一张桌上。
en: A holiday reunion puts old scores and new illnesses on the same table.

text: 你幸福吗？
en: Are you happy? (Êtes-vous heureux?)

text: 不知道从什么时候开始，在什么东西上面都有个日期……我开始怀疑，在这个世界上，还有什么东西是不会过期的？
en: I don't know when it started… everything comes with an expiry date. I wonder if there's anything in this world that doesn't.

text: 如果记忆也是一个罐头的话，我希望这一罐罐头不会过期。如果一定要加一个日子的话——我希望是一万年。
女人的路，走来走去还是一个圆。
en: A woman’s road, walked again and again, is still a circle.

text: 最干净的人，往往最有资格把自己洗白。
en: The cleanest man is often the one most entitled to wash himself clean.

text: 玫瑰花蕾。
en: Rosebud.

text: 你负责写散文诗，我负责提供战争。
en: You provide the prose poems, and I'll provide the war.

text: 如果我不是很富有，我也许会成为一个真正伟大的人。
en: If I hadn't been very rich, I might have been a really great man.

text: 你说起人民，就好像他们属于你似的。
en: You talk about the people as though you owned them, as though they belong to you.

text: 是你？……是的，我看得见了。
en: You? … Yes, I can see now.

text: 太阳，只为早起的人升起。
en: The sun rises for those who get up early.

text: 我听不见，但我看得见。
en: I cannot hear, but I can see.

text: 我们是兄弟。
en: We're brothers.

text: 你看，那个人好像一条狗啊。
en: Look—that guy looks like a dog.

text: 般若波罗蜜！
娘子，快跟牛魔王一起出来看上帝！
每个女人都有最脆弱的一点。有的是后颈，有的是腰，有的是手。对克莱尔来说，在那种姿势、那种光线下，就是她的膝盖。
en: Every woman has her most vulnerable point. For some, it's the nape of the neck, the waist, the hands. For Claire, in that position, in that light, it was her knee.

text: 舞会一旦下毒，天堂和地狱只隔一支舞。
en: Once the party is poisoned, heaven and hell are only a dance apart.

text: 那么——接下来会是什么？
en: What's it going to be then, eh?

text: 我被治好了，千真万确。
en: I was cured, all right.

text: 善是被选择出来的。当一个人不能选择，他就不再是人。
en: Goodness is chosen. When a man cannot choose, he ceases to be a man.

text: 我做我做的一切，就因为我乐意。
en: I do what I do because I like to do it.

text: 电影就是一个梦。
en: Cinema is a dream.

text: 现在，我终于长大了。
en: Now, I have finally grown up.

text: 请以你的名字呼唤我，我便以我的名字回应你。
en: Call me by your name and I'll call you by mine.

text: 可为了不去感受，就让自己什么都感觉不到——多可惜啊！
en: But to make yourself feel nothing so as not to feel anything — what a waste!

text: 此刻有悲伤，有痛苦。别杀掉它——连同你感受过的快乐一起。
en: Right now, there's sorrow, pain. Don't kill it, and with it the joy you've felt.

text: 请记住我。
en: Remember me.

text: 当活着的世界再没有一个人记得你，你就会从这个世界消失——我们管那叫「终极死亡」。
en: When there's no one left in the living world who remembers you, you disappear from this world. We call it the Final Death.

text: 代码未知——我们读不懂彼此。
en: Code unknown—we cannot read each other.

text: 一个谎，要一百个谎去圆。
en: One lie needs a hundred more to keep it standing.

text: 如果你走进另一栋房子——你可能再也回不来了。
en: If you walk into another house, you might never come back.

text: 战争从午夜开始。
en: The war starts at midnight.

text: 我的灵魂是一座没有门的花园。
en: My soul is a garden with no door.

text: 其实，我是一个演员。
en: Actually, I'm an actor.

text: 努力！奋斗！
我养你啊！
你先照顾好自己吧，傻瓜。
原来你也在这里。
en: So you were here too.

text: 黎小军同志，我来香港的目的不是你，你来香港的目的也不是我。
傻女，听我说，现在立刻回家，洗个热水澡——明天起来，满街都是男人，个个都比豹哥好。
我想让你们体验一下，失去最重要的东西时是什么感觉。
en: I want you to experience what it feels like to lose the most precious thing.

text: 最安全的办法，是把自己活成所有人期望的影子。
en: The safest way is to live as the shadow everyone expects.

text: 我轻蔑你。
en: I despise you. / J'ai mépris pour toi.

text: 如果你知道他们在做什么，你还会保持沉默吗？
en: If you knew what they were doing, would you still stay silent?

text: 我用了十年建成海豚产业，又用了三十五年想把它拆掉。
en: I spent ten years building the dolphin industry, and the past thirty-five trying to tear it down.

text: 海豚的微笑，是自然界最大的错觉。
en: The dolphin's smile is nature's greatest illusion.

text: 等我回来。
en: Wait for me to come back.

text: 我也是有理想的人，我的理想就是不上班。
en: I've got ambitions too—mainly, never having a real job.

text: 牌子！班尼路！
注意素质！
别摸我。
我很痛苦，请抱抱我。
en: I am in pain. I need someone to hold me.

text: 新鲜的，永远更好。
en: New is always better.

text: 可我试过了，对不对？该死，至少我试过了。
en: But I tried, didn't I? Goddamnit, at least I did that.

text: 你们这些疯子里，哪个有胆？
en: Which one of you nuts has got any guts?

text: 你是谁？
en: Who are you?

text: 我仍保有——我的羽饰（panache）。
en: Yet something stays mine — my panache.

text: 曾经有一份真诚的爱情放在我面前，我没有珍惜……
en: There was once a sincere love placed before me, and I did not cherish it…

text: 我的意中人是个盖世英雄，有一天他会踩着七色云彩来娶我。
我猜中了前头，可是我猜不着这结局。
你看那个人，好奇怪哟，像一条狗。
辩护未必需要真相。
en: A defense doesn't necessarily need the truth.

text: 果然，人是你杀的吧。
你也是共犯。
既然一切都坏了，那就让一切都坏掉吧。
en: Since everything is spoiled, let everything be spoiled.

text: 我还没死呢。
en: I ain't dead yet.

text: 有时候我觉得自己在为一条没时间过的生活挣扎。我想让它有意义。
en: Sometimes I just feel like I'm fighting for a life I just ain't got time to live. I want it to mean something.

text: 世家的晚宴一开，堕落就会按席次入座。
en: Once the dynasty dinner begins, decadence takes its seat by rank.

text: 我已经看过了一切。
en: I've seen it all.

text: 不拿金牌，一切都等于零。
en: If you don't win the gold, nothing else matters.

text: 你要么死去成为英雄，要么活得够久，眼看着自己变成恶棍。
en: You either die a hero, or you live long enough to see yourself become the villain.

text: 干嘛这么严肃？
en: Why so serious?

text: 这座城市配得上更高档的罪犯。
en: This city deserves a better class of criminal.

text: 哥谭需要我是什么，我就是什么。
en: I'm whatever Gotham needs me to be.

text: 他是哥谭应得的英雄，却不是此刻需要的英雄。
en: He's the hero Gotham deserves, but not the one it needs right now.

text: 他们让我们都为这一天受训：「无畏、骄傲、孤独。不需要任何人，只要牺牲。一切为了祖国。」天哪，全是空话。
en: They made us all train for this day: 'To be fearless and proud and alone. To need no one, just sacrifice. All for the Fatherland.' Oh God, all just empty words.

text: 拍电影的时候，生活反而成了幻觉。
en: While we make films, life itself becomes the illusion.

text: 你是个女巫！
en: You are a witch!

text: 天亮以前，阁楼里只剩一个人，和还没讲完的理由。
en: Before daybreak, only one man remains in the attic — and a reason still unfinished.

text: 那一分钟，我记得非常清楚。
en: I remember that minute very clearly.

text: 我听别人说，这世界上有一种鸟是没有脚的。它只能一直地飞呀飞，飞累了就在风里睡觉。这种鸟一辈子只能下地一次——那一次，就是它死的时候。
及时行乐。孩子们，让你们的生命变得非凡。
en: Carpe diem. Seize the day, boys. Make your lives extraordinary.

text: 哦，船长，我的船长！
en: O Captain! My Captain!

text: 我们读诗、写诗，并非因为它好玩。我们读诗、写诗，因为我们是人类的一员，而人类充满了激情。医药、法律、商业、工程，这些崇高的追求足以支撑人的一生。但诗歌、美、浪漫、爱，这些才是我们活着的意义。
en: We don't read and write poetry because it's cute. We read and write poetry because we are members of the human race. And the human race is filled with passion. Medicine, law, business, engineering: these are noble pursuits and necessary to sustain life. But poetry, beauty, romance, love: these are what we stay alive for.

text: 我步入丛林，因为我希望活得有意义。我希望活得深刻，汲取生命中所有的精华，以免当我生命终结时，发现自己从来没有活过。
en: I went to the woods because I wanted to live deliberately. I wanted to live deep and suck out all the marrow of life. To put to rout all that was not life, and not, when I had come to die, discover that I had not lived.

text: 如果连自己是谁都不知道，死刑又怎样执行？
en: If a man no longer knows who he is, how can you hang him?

text: 美是感觉能达到的最高形式。
en: Beauty is the highest form the senses can attain.

text: 一枪，一杀，不许失手。
en: One shot. One kill. No exceptions.

text: 这就是现在——这不是别的东西。这就是现在。
en: This is this. This ain't something else. This is this.

text: 想吃肉，就得等。
en: If you want meat, you have to wait.

text: 我不想成为环境的产物——我要让环境成为我的产物。
en: I don't want to be a product of my environment. I want my environment to be a product of me.

text: 我年轻时，人们说我们可以当警察或当罪犯。今天我要告诉你的是：当你面对一把上膛的枪，这两者有什么区别？
en: When I was your age, they would say we can become cops or criminals... Today, what I'm saying to you is this: when you're facing a loaded gun, what's the difference?

text: 没人会给你，你得自己去拿。
en: No one gives it to you. You have to take it.

text: 也许有。也许没有。也许你该去问问你自己。
en: Maybe. Maybe not. Maybe go fuck yourself.

text: 我就是爱尔兰人。这辈子有点不对劲，我也能扛。
en: I'm fucking Irish. I'll deal with something being wrong for the rest of my life.

text: 你们是城市人，我是森林人。
en: You are city people. I am a forest man.

text: 我曾经想做最坏的人。现在只想做最好的爸爸。
en: I used to want to be the greatest villain. Now I just want to be the best dad.

text: 它毛绒绒的，我要死了！
en: It's so fluffy I'm gonna die!

text: 电灯泡。
en: Light bulb.

text: 大多数人宁愿被甜蜜的谎言说服，也不愿听刺耳的真话。
en: Most people would rather be persuaded by pleasant lies than by unpleasant facts.

text: 我从未同时感到如此与自己疏离——又如此真切地存在于世界。
en: And never have I felt so deeply at one and the same time so detached from myself and so present in the world.

text: 有便宜不沾，王八蛋。
en: Only a bastard passes up a bargain.

text: 第一件事，是确认尸体真的死了。
en: The first thing is to make sure the corpse is dead.

text: 谋杀究竟是一门艺术，还是一门科学？
en: Is murder an art or a science?

text: 欢迎来参加派对，伙计。
en: Welcome to the party, pal.

text: 呀哈——去你的，混蛋。
en: Yippee-ki-yay, motherfucker.

text: 来西海岸吧，我们聚一聚，乐一乐。
en: Come out to the coast, we'll get together, have a few laughs.

text: 偷走六亿美金，他们一定会找你——除非他们认为你已经死了。
en: When you steal six hundred million, they will find you, unless they think you're already dead.

text: 一句对不起，要走几十年才说得出口。
en: One apology can take decades before it can be spoken.

text: 时间已经停止了，剩下的就是慢慢变老。
在不许离婚的地方，谋杀成了手续。
en: Where divorce is forbidden, murder becomes paperwork.

text: 姜戈。D 不发音。
en: Django. The D is silent.

text: 先生们，你们曾激起我的好奇。现在——你们得到了我的注意。
en: Gentlemen, you had my curiosity. Now you have my attention.

text: 英雄可以是任何人。
en: A hero can be anyone.

text: 你只是适应了黑暗。我在黑暗里出生——被它塑造。
en: You merely adopted the dark. I was born in it, moulded by it.

text: 胜利打败了你。
en: Victory has defeated you.

text: 你得反抗那股力量。
en: You’ve got to fight the power.

text: 医生，永远做对的事。
en: Doctor. Always do the right thing.

text: 有朋友在的地方，就是好地方。多比很高兴能和朋友在一起……哈利·波特。
en: Such a beautiful place, to be with friends. Dobby is happy to be with his friend, Harry Potter.

text: 这里长眠着多比——一个自由的小精灵。
en: Here lies Dobby, a free elf.

text: 电车开往哪儿不重要，重要的是它还在开。
en: It does not matter where the tram goes — only that it still runs.

text: 阿提卡！阿提卡！
en: Attica! Attica!

text: 人和狗之间，有时比人和人之间更像同盟。
en: Between a man and his dogs, the alliance can feel stronger than among men.

text: 有些人，不配被宽恕。
en: Some people do not deserve to be forgiven.

text: 有些事，必须亲自动手。
en: Some things you have to do yourself.

text: 甜蜜的生活，甜的是灯光，苦的是清晨。
en: The sweet life: lights are sweet, mornings are bitter.

text: 用红绳把彼此绑在一起。
en: Bind each other with a red cord.

text: 你干吗穿着那身蠢死人的人皮外套？
en: Why are you wearing that stupid man suit?

text: 世上每个生灵，最后都孤独地死去。
en: Every living creature on this earth dies alone.

text: 我希望世界终结的时候，我能松一口气——因为还有那么多值得期待。
en: I hope that when the world comes to an end, I can breathe a sigh of relief, because there will be so much to look forward to.

text: 有些预兆，看见了也不该相信。
en: Some signs should not be believed, even when you see them.

text: 是的，我杀了他。我为了钱——也为了一个女人——杀了他。结果呢？钱没拿到，女人也没到手。真够惨的，对吧？
en: Yes, I killed him. I killed him for money—and a woman—and I didn't get the money and I didn't get the woman. Pretty, isn't it?

text: 我也爱你，沃尔特。
en: I love you, too.

text: 一路直行。
en: Straight down the line.

text: 如果战争败了，德意志民族是否灭亡也就无关紧要了。
en: If the war is lost, it is of no concern to me if the people perish.

text: 施泰纳的进攻，是一个命令！
en: Steiner's attack was an order!

text: 我看中的男人，要么是英雄，要么是疯子。
en: The men I fall for are either heroes—or madmen.

text: 我这龙门客栈，进来的多，出去的少。
江湖险恶，人心更险。
en: The martial world is dangerous; the human heart is more dangerous still.

text: 我们用电影相爱，也用街头去革命。
en: We fell in love through cinema — and took the streets for revolution.

text: 为什么你不停地画？因为太阳驱使着我。
en: Why do you paint without rest? Because the sun drives me.

text: 资本主义发明了恐怖主义，好迫使国家更好地保护它。
en: Capitalism invented terrorism to force the state to protect it better.

text: 你给我时间和地点，我给你五分钟窗口。
en: You give me a time and a place, I give you a five minute window.

text: 世界上只有一种病，穷病。
en: There's only one disease in the world: poverty.

text: 领导，我求求你——我不想死，我想活着。
他才二十岁——他只是想活着，犯了什么罪！
流氓跟细菌是一样的。
en: Yakuza are just like germs.

text: 梦，是从深处传来的讯息。
en: Dreams are messages from the deep.

text: 我绝不能恐惧。恐惧是思维的杀手，是带来彻底毁灭的小小死亡。
en: I must not fear. Fear is the mind-killer. Fear is the little-death that brings total obliteration.

text: 能摧毁一样东西的人，就能控制它。
en: He who can destroy a thing, controls a thing.

text: 沙子会把一切填平——逃出去的路，也会被重新埋上。
en: Sand levels everything — even the path you dug out will be buried again.

text: 股票，是人对未来的预测。测对了，就是赢家；测错了，就是输家。
en: Stocks are people's predictions of the future. Guess right, you're a winner; guess wrong, you're a loser.

text: 你要活，我陪你；你想死，也陪你。
en: If you want to live, I'll go with you; if you want to die, I'll go with you too.

text: 与狼共舞！我是风中之发。你看得见我是你的朋友吗？你看得见你会永远是我的朋友吗？
en: Dances With Wolves! I am Wind In His Hair. Do you see that I am your friend? Can you see that you will always be my friend?

text: 我还没有结婚的打算。
en: I have no intention of getting married yet.

text: 我最讨厌别人见面时说上一句：好久不见。
en: What I hate most is when people greet me with: Long time no see.

text: 饮食男女，人之大欲存焉。
en: Food, drink, man, woman—basic human desires.

text: 人生不能像做菜，把所有的料都准备好了才下锅。
其实一家人住在一个屋檐下，照样可以各过各的日子。可是从心里产生的那种顾忌，才是一个家之所以为家的意义。
女儿……爸爸尝不出味道来了。
岁月是贼——它偷走你的一切，却让你感谢它来过。
en: Time is a thief—it steals everything, and somehow you still thank it for coming.

text: 做人，最要紧是信。
鞋字半边难，也有半边佳。难一步，佳一步。
我们约好见面，然后让整座城市替我们缺席。
en: We agree to meet — then let the whole city keep our absence.

text: 在所有可能的地方，我只想和你待在这里。
en: Of all the places I could be, I just want to be here with you.

text: 在另一种人生里，我会很喜欢和你一起洗衣、报税。
en: In another life, I would have really liked just doing laundry and taxes with you.

text: 这就是我战斗的方式。
en: This is how I fight.

text: 灵感不来的时候，整个生涯都像一场排练。
en: When inspiration will not come, a whole career feels like a rehearsal.

text: 战后的小学，教的不只是书，还有怎样把人当人。
en: In a postwar elementary school, they teach not only books — but how to treat a person as a person.

text: 我不是动物！我是人！我是人！
en: I am not an animal! I am a human being! I am a man!

text: 没有什么会死去。
en: Nothing will die.

text: 不想干就申请退出！
en: Ask to leave!

text: 敌人不在山上，在系统里面。
en: The enemy is not up on the hill — it is inside the system.

text: 不——我才是你的父亲。
en: No. I am your father.

text: 做，或者不做。没有「试试看」。
en: Do. Or do not. There is no try.

text: 战争并不能让人伟大。
en: Wars not make one great.

text: 这笔买卖越来越不划算了。
en: This deal is getting worse all the time.

text: 我爱你。
en: I love you.

text: 我知道。
en: I know.

text: 别跟我说什么概率！
en: Never tell me the odds!

text: 杀了人，爱并没有完——亡灵会把夜路照得更亮。
en: After the murder, love is not finished — the dead light the night road even brighter.

text: 这个家，也就这样了。
en: This family — this is how it ends.

text: 我爱你三千遍。
en: I love you three thousand.

text: 旅程的一部分，就是终点。
en: Part of the journey is the end.

text: 我就是钢铁侠。
en: I am Iron Man.

text: 复仇者——集合。
en: Avengers... assemble.

text: 死并不是结束，只是换一个角度看这座城市。
en: Death is not an end — only another angle on the city.

text: 女儿要走的路，做父亲的终究拦不住。
en: A father cannot forever block the road his daughter chooses.

text: E.T.打电话回家。
en: E.T. phone home.

text: 我会一辈子相信你——每一天。
en: I'll believe in you all my life, every day.

text: 蒙托克见。
en: Meet me in Montauk.

text: 为什么只要对方稍给我一点注意，我就会爱上她？
en: Why do I fall in love with every woman I see who shows me the least bit of attention?

text: 我只是个一团糟的女孩，想给自己找一点安宁。别把你那份也摊到我头上。
en: I'm just a fucked-up girl who's lookin' for my own peace of mind. Don't assign me yours.

text: 我看不出你有什么地方是我不喜欢的。
en: I can't see anything I don't like about you.

text: 健忘的人有福了，他们连自己的过错都一并占了好运。
en: Blessed are the forgetful, for they get the better even of their blunders.

text: 当你爱一样东西，你就会保护它。
en: When you love something, you protect it.

text: 基督的力量命令你——滚开！
en: The power of Christ compels you!

text: 我不是蕾根。
en: I'm not Regan.

text: 没有人能离开。
en: No one can leave.

text: 换一张脸，不等于换得了一个人。
en: A new face does not give you a new person.

text: 每个人都有失恋的时候。
en: Everyone goes through a period of heartbreak.

text: 我们必须在这个世界上幸福。
en: We must be happy in this world.

text: 不疯魔，不成活。
en: Without obsession, there is no art.

text: 说的是一辈子！差一年，一个月，一天，一个时辰，都不算一辈子！
我本是男儿郎，又不是女娇娥。
人，得自个儿成全自个儿。
生活不只是一点钱，你知道吗？你看你现在——多好的天气。我真是不懂。
en: There's more to life than a little money, you know. Don'tcha know that? And here ya are, and it's a beautiful day. Well. I just don't understand it.

text: 你要出人头地。
en: You have to make something of yourself.

text: 我觉得自己像在掉叶子。
en: I feel as if I'm losing all my leaves.

text: 我要妈妈。把外套给我，我要回家……我要妈妈。
en: I want my mummy. Get my coat. I want to go home... I want my mummy.

text: 我们所能决定的，只有如何利用被给予的时间。
en: All we have to decide is what to do with the time that is given us.

text: 你不能通过！
en: You shall not pass!

text: 我会陪你去到最后——一直走进魔多的火焰深处。
en: I would have gone with you to the end, into the very fires of Mordor.

text: 我许过诺，佛罗多先生：「不许丢下他，山姆怀斯·詹吉。」我打算遵守。
en: I made a promise, Mr Frodo. A promise. 'Don't you leave him, Samwise Gamgee.' And I don't mean to.

text: 没有人能就这么走进魔多。
en: One does not simply walk into Mordor.

text: 魔戒的主人只有一个——而且他不会分享权力。
en: There is only one Lord of the Ring. Only one who can bend it to his will. And he does not share power.

text: 人生过得很快。如果你不时停下来四处看看，可能就会错过它。
en: Life moves pretty fast. If you don't stop and look around once in a while, you could miss it.

text: 菲利斯·布勒，你是我的英雄。
en: Ferris Bueller, you're my hero.

text: 问题不是「我们要做什么」——问题是不做什么。
en: The question isn't 'what are we going to do'. The question is 'what aren't we going to do?'

text: 我有话要说。
en: I have something to say.

text: 你承受不了真相！
en: You can't handle the truth!

text: 你需要我在那道墙上。
en: You want me on that wall. You need me on that wall.

text: 我在距离四千个受训要杀我的古巴人三百码的地方吃早餐。
en: I eat breakfast 300 yards from 4000 Cubans who are trained to kill me.

text: 搏击俱乐部第一条规则：不要谈论搏击俱乐部。
en: The first rule of Fight Club is: you do not talk about Fight Club.

text: 你拥有的东西，最终拥有了你。
en: The things you own end up owning you.

text: 只有失去一切之后，我们才自由地做任何事。
en: It's only after we've lost everything that we're free to do anything.

text: 你不是你的工作，不是你银行里的存款。
en: You're not your job. You're not how much money you have in the bank.

text: 我是杰克燃烧的受挫感。
en: I am Jack's inflamed sense of rejection.

text: 当生活让你失望时，你知道该怎么办吗？继续游。继续游。
en: When life gets you down, you know what you gotta do? Just keep swimming.

text: 我看着你，就是回家。
en: I look at you, and I'm home.

text: 我保证过不让他出事。
en: I promised I'd never let anything happen to him.

text: 初恋是小事——却足以把一辈子的天气改掉。
en: First love is a little thing—yet it can change the weather of a whole life.

text: 鱼儿难捕租税重，捕鱼人儿世世穷。
en: Fish are hard to catch and the tax is heavy — fisherfolk stay poor generation after generation.

text: 我的骡子不喜欢人笑它。
en: My mule don't like people laughing. He gets the crazy idea you're laughing at him.

text: 备三口棺材。
en: Get three coffins ready.

text: 我弄错了——四口。
en: My mistake. Four coffins.

text: 一个人必须有梦想。
en: A man must have a dream.

text: 溃败的人在跑，跑的不是路，是故乡。
en: The defeated keep running — not along a road, but away from home.

text: 有些人浅薄，有些人金玉其外败絮其中。有一天，你会遇到一个彩虹般绚丽的人；当你遇到这个人后，会觉得其他人不过是浮云。
en: Some of us get dipped in flat, some in satin, some in gloss.... But every once in a while you find someone who's iridescent, and when you do, nothing will ever compare.

text: 见到布莱斯·罗斯基的第一天，我就心动了。是他的眼睛——那双眼睛里有种闪闪发光的东西。
en: The first day I met Bryce Loski, I flipped. It was those eyes, something in those dazzling eyes.

text: 一幅画大于各部分之和——牛、草地、阳光，放在一起就可能变成魔法。
en: A painting is more than the sum of its parts.

text: 别人笑我忒疯癫，我笑他人看不穿。
en: Others laugh at me for being too crazy; I laugh at them for not seeing through.

text: 十口心思，思君思国思社稷。
小强！小强你怎么了小强？！
我只是想过自己的生活。
en: I only want to live my own life.

text: 设身处地去理解你的敌人。
en: Empathize with your enemy.

text: 理性救不了我们。
en: Rationality will not save us.

text: 为了行善，你可能不得不作恶。
en: In order to do good, you may have to engage in evil.

text: 相信与看见，常常都是错的。
en: Belief and seeing are both often wrong.

text: 当生命没有价值时，死亡有时也会有它的价格。
en: Where life has no value, death, sometimes, has its price.

text: 到了七千转，一切都会隐去。机器变得没了重量，简直消失。只剩一具身体穿过空间与时间。七千转——你在那儿遇见它。它问你唯一要紧的问题：你是谁？
en: There's a point at 7,000 RPM where everything fades. The machine becomes weightless. Just disappears. And all that's left is a body moving through space and time. 7,000 RPM. That's where you meet it. ... Asks you a question. The only question that matters. Who are you?

text: 生活就像一盒巧克力，你永远不知道下一颗是什么味道。
en: Life is like a box of chocolates. You never know what you're gonna get.

text: 做傻事的才是傻子。
en: Stupid is as stupid does.

text: 跑，福雷斯特，快跑！
en: Run, Forrest, run!

text: 我不聪明，但我知道什么是爱。
en: I'm not a smart man, but I know what love is.

text: 死亡只是生命的一部分。
en: Death is just a part of life.

text: 我撒谎——是为了能喘气。
en: I lie so I can breathe.

text: 停战前的最后一颗子弹，往往最没有意义。
en: The last bullet before an armistice is often the most meaningless.

text: 爱，就是把别人的需要放在自己前面。
en: Love is putting someone else's needs before yours.

text: 反正寒冷从来困扰不了我。
en: The cold never bothered me anyway.

text: 你想不想堆雪人？
en: Do you want to build a snowman?

text: 逃过海峡，逃不过自己心里的火。
en: You can flee across the strait — not the fire inside.

text: 死人只知道一件事：活着更好。
en: The dead know only one thing: it is better to be alive.

text: 这是我的步枪。类似的还有很多，但这把是我的。
en: This is my rifle. There are many like it, but this one is mine.

text: 世界上最致命的武器，是一个海军陆战队员和他的步枪。
en: The deadliest weapon in the world is a Marine and his rifle.

text: 7.62 毫米，全金属被甲弹。
en: 7.62 millimeter. Full metal jacket.

text: 是你吗，约翰·韦恩？这是在拍我吗？
en: Is that you, John Wayne? Is this me?

text: 我只想成为我自己。
en: I only want to become myself.

text: 你站在他们那边，对不对？
en: You're on their side, aren't you?

text: 我们一路奋战，不是为了改变世界，而是为了不让世界改变我们。
en: We fight on, not to change the world, but so the world won't change us.

text: 认知不足。
熔炉的时刻到了：要么解放，要么灭亡。
en: The hour of the furnaces has come: liberation or death.

text: 完美的谋杀停在电梯里——外面的夜还在继续。
en: The perfect murder stalls in an elevator — outside, the night goes on.

text: 以眼还眼，只会让全世界都盲目。
en: An eye for an eye only ends up making the whole world blind.

text: 我是穆斯林，是印度教徒，是基督徒，也是犹太人。
en: I am a Muslim and a Hindu and a Christian and a Jew.

text: 要抓魔鬼，有时得先跟恶棍握手。
en: To catch a devil, sometimes you shake hands with a gangster first.

text: 废墟里的规矩只有一条：肉体换口粮，背叛就挨打。
en: In the ruins there is only one rule: flesh for rations — betrayal means a beating.

text: 游向大海时，我没有留力气游回来。
en: I never saved anything for the swim back.

text: 人类的灵魂没有基因。
en: There is no gene for the human spirit.

text: 对一个本就不属于这个世界的人来说，离开它居然这么难。
en: For someone who was never meant for this world, I must admit I am having a hard time leaving it.

text: 我属于一个新的底层……歧视不再看社会地位或肤色——我们把它做成了一门科学。
en: I belonged to a new underclass... We now have discrimination down to a science.

text: 退后，伙计。我是科学家。
en: Back off, man. I'm a scientist.

text: 我们来了，我们看了，我们收拾了它！
en: We came, we saw, we kicked its ass!

text: 别让两条射线交叉。
en: Don't cross the streams.

text: 这姑娘烤定了。
en: This chick is toast!

text: 世界上有两种人，我的朋友——有枪的，和要挖的。你，挖。
en: There are two kinds of people in the world, my friend: those with a loaded gun, and those who dig. You dig.

text: 该开枪的时候就开枪，别废话。
en: When you have to shoot, shoot. Don't talk.

text: 靠干活谋生的人，为什么还要拼命干活？
en: If you work for a living, why do you kill yourself working?

text: 废墟里长大的孩子，最先学会的不是哭，是怎样把罪过扛回家。
en: A child raised in ruins learns first not to cry, but how to carry guilt home.

text: 出去！
en: Get out!

text: 我是运输安全局的！
en: I'm TSA!

text: 剪短头发、换上新衣，并不等于立刻长成大人。
en: Cutting your hair and changing clothes does not make you grown overnight.

text: 网络广阔无垠。
en: The net is vast and infinite.

text: 你想要保持原样的努力——正是束缚你的东西。
en: Your effort to remain what you are is what limits you.

text: 我们今生所做的一切，都会在永恒中回响。
en: What we do in life echoes in eternity.

text: 我叫马克西姆斯·德西姆斯·梅里迪乌斯，北方军团的统帅……被杀害之子的父亲，被杀害之妻的丈夫。我必将复仇——今生，或来世。
en: My name is Maximus Decimus Meridius, commander of the Armies of the North... Father to a murdered son, husband to a murdered wife. And I will have my vengeance, in this life or the next.

text: 曾有过一个罗马之梦。只能低声说它——越是大声讲，它就越溜走。
en: There was a dream that was Rome. You could only whisper it. The more you talked about it, the more it slipped away.

text: 我们凡人不过是尘与影。尘与影，马克西姆斯！
en: We mortals are but shadows and dust. Shadows and dust, Maximus!

text: 我难道不够仁慈？
en: Am I not merciful?

text: 若目标相同、心胸开阔，习惯与语言的差异便不足道。
en: Differences of habit and language are nothing at all if our aims are identical and our hearts are open.

text: 黑暗而艰难的日子就要来了。很快，我们都要在「正确」与「容易」之间做选择。
en: Dark and difficult times lie ahead. Soon we must all face the choice between what is right and what is easy.

text: 想知道一个人是什么样，就看他怎么对待比他低一等的人，而不是同侪。
en: If you want to know what a man's like, take a good look at how he treats his inferiors, not his equals.

text: 街上叫她神女，家里等她当妈——名字从来不是她选的。
en: On the street they call her a goddess; at home they wait for a mother — she never chose either name.

text: 我会给他一个他无法拒绝的条件。
en: I'm gonna make him an offer he can't refuse.

text: 这不是私人恩怨，纯属生意。
en: It's not personal, Sonny. It's strictly business.

text: 不花时间陪伴家人的男人，永远算不上真正的男人。
en: A man who doesn't spend time with his family can never be a real man.

text: 也许有一天——也许那一天永远不会来——我会请你为我做一件事。
en: Someday, and that day may never come, I'll call upon you to do a service for me.

text: 把枪留下，把奶油卷带走。
en: Leave the gun. Take the cannoli.

text: 亲近你的朋友，更要亲近你的敌人。
en: Keep your friends close, but your enemies closer.

text: 如果历史教会了我们什么，那就是：任何人都可以被杀掉。
en: If history has taught us anything, it's that you can kill anyone.

text: 我聪明！不像他们说的那样蠢……我聪明，我要的是尊重！
en: I'm smart! Not like everybody says... I'm smart and I want respect!

text: 我不觉得得把所有人都灭掉，汤姆——只要灭掉我的敌人。
en: I don't feel I have to wipe everybody out, Tom. Just my enemies.

text: 正当我以为已经脱身，他们又把我拉了回去。
en: Just when I thought I was out, they pull me back in.

text: 永远不要恨你的敌人——这会影响你的判断。
en: Never hate your enemies. It affects your judgment.

text: 留下或离开，祷告都要先问自己怕不怕死。
en: Stay or leave — prayer first asks whether you fear death.

text: 我会找到金子，然后回家。
en: I'll find gold and go home.

text: 在这套体系里，你不是在犯罪，你是在上班。
en: Inside this system, you are not committing crimes — you are going to work.

text: 每当我想起我的妻子，我总是先想到她的头。
en: When I think of my wife, I always think of her head.

text: 男人总把这当作终极赞美，不是吗？——酷女孩。
en: Men always say that as the defining compliment, don't they? A cool girl.

text: 我就是你娶回来的那个贱人。
en: I'm the cunt you married.

text: 演戏，也是在演历史。
en: To act is also to act out history.

text: 大人总是在说些没用的话。
en: Adults are always saying things that mean nothing.

text: 大人整天说些没用的废话。
你知道吗，这家戏院闹鬼。闹鬼。有鬼。
en: Do you know this theater is haunted? This theater is haunted. Ghosts.

text: 打记事起，我就一直想当个黑帮。
en: As far back as I can remember, I always wanted to be a gangster.

text: 哪里好笑？我是小丑吗？我逗你笑了？
en: Funny how? I mean, funny like I'm a clown? I amuse you?

text: 永远不咬朋友——永远闭嘴。
en: Never rat on your friends and always keep your mouth shut.

text: 就一个词：塑料。
en: Just one word: plastics.

text: 罗宾逊太太……你在引诱我。
en: Mrs. Robinson, you're trying to seduce me.

text: 先生，您是来谈婚外情的吗？
en: Are you here for an affair, sir?

text: 离我的草坪远点。
en: Get off my lawn.

text: 有没有发现，偶尔会撞见一个你不该惹的人？——那就是我。
en: Ever notice how you come across somebody once in a while you shouldn't have fucked with? That's me.

text: 国界，是人们画在地图上的线。
en: Frontiers are lines people draw on maps.

text: 别开枪——我们是英国人！……啊不，是法国人！
en: Don't shoot—we're English! …Ah no, French!

text: 凡是有饥饿的人在争取食物，凡是警察在打人，我都在那里。
en: Wherever there’s a fight so hungry people can eat, I’ll be there.

text: 我们就是人民——我们要走下去。
en: Why, we're the people — we go on.

text: 遇上麻烦、受了伤、需要人帮——去找穷人。只有穷人才会帮你。
en: If you're in trouble or hurt or need — go to poor people. They're the only ones that'll help.

text: 1945年9月21日，那是我死去的夜晚。
en: September 21, 1945. That was the night I died.

text: 我并不是想过上那种生活，我是想成为那种生活的王。
en: I didn't just want to live the high life — I wanted to be king of the high life.

text: 佛肚空空，装的全是有钱人的秘密。
en: The Buddha's belly is hollow—stuffed with the secrets of the rich.

text: 对不起——我不想当皇帝。那不是我的事。我不想统治或征服任何人。
en: I'm sorry, but I don't want to be an emperor. That's not my business. I don't want to rule or conquer anyone.

text: 我们想得太多，感受太少。
en: We think too much and feel too little.

text: 比机器更重要的是人性。
en: More than machinery, we need humanity.

text: 以民主之名——让我们团结起来！
en: In the name of democracy, let us all unite!

text: 三百人要越狱。
en: Three hundred men are going to escape.

text: 这世上到处都是寂寞的人，等着别人迈出第一步。
en: The world is full of lonely people waiting to make the first move.

text: 因为只有天才是不够的——改变人心，需要勇气。
en: Because genius is not enough. It takes courage to change people's hearts.

text: 如果我不够黑，也不够白——那你告诉我，托尼，我到底是什么？
en: If I'm not black enough and if I'm not white enough... then tell me, Tony, what am I?

text: 我累了，老板。我好想回家。
en: I'm tired, boss. … I want to go home.

text: 你告诉天父：你们做了一件善事。
en: You tell God the Father it was a kindness you done.

text: 我厌倦了人与人之间的丑恶。就像脑袋里扎满了碎玻璃。
en: I'm tired of people bein' ugly to each other. It's like pieces of glass in my head.

text: 我们都欠一次死，谁也不能例外——这我知道。可有时候……哦上帝，绿里这条路真长。
en: We each owe a death, there are no exceptions, I know that, but sometimes, oh God, the Green Mile is so long.

text: 我想听真话。
en: I want to hear the truth.

text: 做人呢，最要紧是开心。
en: The most important thing about being human is to be happy.

text: 家的味道，往往是最普通的那一碗。
en: The taste of home is often the plainest bowl.

text: 要是你被困住了——每天都一模一样——而这件事永远不会有尽头呢？
en: What would you do if you were stuck in one place, and every day was exactly the same, and nothing that you did mattered?

text: 我是神明。不是那个上帝。
en: I'm a god. I'm not the God.

text: 我是格鲁特。
en: I am Groot.

text: 除了我，没有东西像我！
en: Ain't no thing like me except me!

text: 我们是格鲁特。
en: We are Groot.

text: 你知道比枪炮更强大的是什么吗？是人。
en: Do you know what's stronger than guns? People.

text: 明天又是新的一天。
en: Tomorrow is another day.

text: 坦白说，亲爱的，我一点也不在乎。
en: Frankly, my dear, I don't give a damn.

text: 上帝为我作证，我再也不要挨饿了。
en: As God is my witness, I'll never be hungry again.

text: 我现在无法去想这些，再想下去我会发疯的。我明天再想。
en: I can't think about that right now. If I do, I'll go crazy. I'll think about that tomorrow.

text: 它只是你的一条狗，但你却是它的一生。
en: It's your dog, but you are its whole life.

text: 八公是我的英雄。我没有见过外公——但他们教会了我忠诚的含义。
en: Hachiko was my hero. I never met my grandfather... They taught me the meaning of loyalty...

text: 它会一直等——在你曾经归来的地方。
en: He will keep waiting—at the place where you used to come home.

text: 上帝，请再帮我救一个。
en: Please, Lord, help me get one more.

text: 这世界拼了命要把自己撕碎，我想把其中一点点缝回去——这不该算坏事。
en: With the world so set on tearing itself apart, it don't seem like such a bad thing to me to want to put a little bit of it back together.

text: 公道自在人心。
en: Justice lives in the hearts of the people.

text: 做贪官要奸，做清官要更奸——不然你怎么治得了那些坏人？
我不会放弃我的机会。
en: I'm not throwing away my shot.

text: 少说话，多微笑。
en: Talk less. Smile more.

text: 移民。活儿都是我们干的。
en: Immigrants. We get the job done.

text: 历史正注视着你。
en: History has its eyes on you.

text: 花，还是要画完。
en: Still — finish painting the flower.

text: 有时候命运像一只手，把你往电影那边推。
en: Sometimes fate is a hand that pushes you toward cinema.

text: 我愿意被你骗一辈子。
en: I want to be deceived by you for the rest of my life.

text: 家庭宴席照开，窗外的难民与室内的冷漠隔着一层玻璃。
en: The family banquet goes on — refugees outside and coldness inside are only a pane of glass apart.

text: 不如我们从头来过。
en: Let's start over.

text: 一直以为我跟何宝荣不一样。原来寂寞的时候，所有的人都一样。
我总觉得，站在瀑布下面的，应该是两个人。
别让别人告诉你，你成不了才。即使是我，也不行。
en: Don't ever let somebody tell you you can't do something. Not even me.

text: 如果你有梦想的话，就要去捍卫它。那些一事无成的人想告诉你，你也成不了大器。如果你有理想的话，就要去努力实现。就这样。
en: You got a dream, you gotta protect it. People can't do something themselves, they wanna tell you you can't do it. If you want something, go get it. Period.

text: 我人生中的这个阶段，这一小段，叫做幸福。
en: This part of my life, this little part, is called happiness.

text: 也许幸福是我们只能追求、却永远无法真正拥有的东西。
en: Maybe happiness is something that we can only pursue, and maybe we can actually never have it.

text: 煤炭正在杀死我们。
en: The coal is killing us.

text: L-I-V-E。活着！不然更衣室里你就没什么好吹的。
en: L-I-V-E. Live! Otherwise, you've got nothing to talk about in the locker room.

text: 很多人享受着「死了」的状态——但其实他们没死，只是在回避生活。伸出手去，试试看，哪怕受伤。
en: A lot of people enjoy being dead. But they are not dead, really. They're just backing away from life. Reach out. Take a chance. Get hurt even.

text: 她点的，我也要一份。
en: I'll have what she's having.

text: 男人和女人做不成朋友——因为「性」那部分总会来捣乱。
en: Men and women can't be friends because the sex part always gets in the way.

text: 我今晚来这儿，是因为当你意识到想和谁共度余生时，就会希望余生尽快开始。
en: I came here tonight because when you realize you want to spend the rest of your life with somebody, you want the rest of your life to start as soon as possible.

text: 在南边，金钱可以买到夏天，买不到不被看穿。
en: Down south, money can buy a summer — not the right not to be seen through.

text: 别让自己对任何你无法在三十秒内转身走开的东西产生感情——如果感觉到热度，就这么办。
en: Don't let yourself get attached to anything you are not willing to walk out on in thirty seconds flat if you feel the heat around the corner.

text: 她有一个很棒的屁股！
en: Cause she's got a GREAT ASS!

text: 我做我最擅长的事——抢钱。你做你最擅长的——拦住我这样的人。
en: I do what I do best, I take scores. You do what you do best, try to stop guys like me.

text: 那时候好像永远是夏天，阳光充足，太亮，使得眼前一阵阵发黑。
en: Back then it seemed always summer—the sun so bright it blacked out your eyes.

text: 我的故事总是发生在夏天。炎热的气候使人们裸露得更多——也更难以掩饰心中的欲望。
我想回家，回山上，回爷爷身边。
en: I want to go home—to the mountains, to Grandfather.

text: 你善良。你聪明。你重要。
en: You is kind. You is smart. You is important.

text: 上帝说要爱你的仇敌。这很难。但可以从说真话开始。
en: God says we need to love our enemies. It hard to do. But it can start by telling the truth.

text: 吃。我的。屎。
en: Eat. My. Shit.

text: 从没有人问过我，做我自己是什么滋味。把这个真相说出来之后，我自由了。
en: No one had ever asked me what it feel like to be me. Once I told the truth about that, I felt free.

text: 原谅我。
en: Forgive me.

text: 一个人的痛苦与天下人比，便不再是痛苦。
en: One person's pain, measured against all under heaven, is no longer pain.

text: 剑法的最高境界，是手中无剑，心中也无剑——那是不杀，是和平。
我望向远方，望向世界的尽头。这一天结束之前，末日就会到来。
en: I look into the distance, to the end of the world. Before the day is over, the end will come.

text: 活下去——像牲口一样活下去。
en: Live on—live on like beasts if you must.

text: 运动了——！
我不杀他，是因为他看起来和我一样害怕。我看着他，就像看着自己。
en: I wouldn't kill him, because he looked as frightened as I was. I looked at him, and I saw myself.

text: 这里是博克岛。一年下九个月的雪，剩下三个月——下冰雹。
en: This is Berk. It snows nine months of the year, and hails the other three.

text: 真正做事的人，往往没有名字。
en: Those who truly get things done often have no name.

text: 我不是来做客的——我是来留下的。
en: I'm not here to sit out. I'm here to stay.

text: NASA 确实让女人做一些事，约翰逊先生——不是因为我们穿裙子，是因为我们戴眼镜。
en: Yes, they let women do some things at NASA, Mr. Johnson. And it's not because we wear skirts. It's because we wear glasses.

text: 在 NASA——我们尿的颜色都一样。
en: Here at NASA, we all pee the same color.

text: 公主，这可是我们的命啊。
en: Princess, this is a matter of life and death for us.

text: 快看那边。我第一次知道，天空和大海原来这么蓝。
金子！是金子！
我不会为了钱出卖一个孩子。
en: I will not sell a child for money.

text: 你什么也没看见——在广岛。可记忆偏要你看见。
en: You saw nothing — in Hiroshima. And memory insists that you did.

text: 我要去冒险了！
en: I'm going on an adventure!

text: 是普通人日常的小事——小小的善意与爱——挡住了黑暗。
en: It is the small things, everyday deeds of ordinary folk, that keeps the darkness at bay. Small acts of kindness and love.

text: 楼上楼下凿开一个洞，千禧年的雨就有了落点。
en: Cut a hole between floors, and the millennial rain finally has somewhere to land.

text: 当你能安静一会儿、舒服地享受沉默——那你就知道遇到对的人了。
en: That's when you know you've found somebody special. When you can just shut the fuck up for a minute and comfortably enjoy the silence.

text: 官宣了，老伙计——我是个过气明星。
en: It's official, old buddy. I'm a has-been.

text: 我还没死呢！
en: I’m not dead yet!

text: 不过是擦伤。
en: 'Tis but a scratch.

text: 只是皮外伤。
en: It's just a flesh wound.

text: 死亡正等着你们——带着又大又尖的牙齿！
en: Death awaits you all, with nasty, big, pointy teeth!

text: 一天换一副面孔，谁还分得清哪个是自己。
en: Change faces all day long — who can still tell which one is you?

text: 忘掉圣山，去过你自己的生活。
en: Forget the holy mountain — go live your own life.

text: 似水流年。
en: Years flow away like water.

text: 我只想闯出一条路。
en: I just want to make it.

text: 你不需要变得很坚强，可以向我们撒娇，有爸爸在呢。
en: You don't have to be strong. You can lean on us—Dad is here.

text: 神看得见。
en: God sees.

text: 人一旦碰触到妖怪，妖怪就会消失。
en: If a human touches a spirit, that spirit will disappear.

text: 这里永远有空房——给需要活下去的人。
en: There is always room. At this hotel, there is always room.

text: 这栋房子会把你吞进去。
en: This house will swallow you.

text: 只连接：把散文与激情、世俗与诗意连在一起。
en: Only connect! Only connect the prose and the passion.

text: 找到你了，亲爱的。抱歉我来晚了。我找了你好久。
en: There you are, sweetheart. Sorry I'm late. I was looking everywhere for you.

text: 我已经逃得够多了。终于有了必须守护的东西——那就是你。
我绝不能放弃做人。
en: I will never stop being human.

text: 指节上刻着爱与恨——孩子们比大人更早认出哪一只手。
en: Love and Hate are tattooed on the knuckles — children recognize which hand first.

text: 这不是你的错。
en: It's not your fault.

text: 你会有糟心的日子，但那总会提醒你——注意那些你一直忽略的东西。
en: You'll have bad times, but it'll always wake you up to the things you weren't paying attention to.

text: 如果我问你战争，你会甩出莎士比亚给我……可你说不出它闻起来是什么味道。
en: If I asked you about war, you'd probably throw Shakespeare at me... but you can't tell me what it smells like.

text: 我得去看看一个姑娘。
en: I gotta go see about a girl.

text: 战争是一种毒品。
en: War is a drug.

text: 世界曾把我变成妓女；现在，我要把世界变成妓院。
en: The world made a whore of me; I want to turn the world into a whorehouse.

text: 我是古巴，我的声音就是人民的声音。
en: I am Cuba; my voice is the voice of the people.

text: 出来混，迟早要还的。
en: You play the game, sooner or later you pay.

text: 你不必做一个完美的父母，才能做一个好父母。
en: You don't need to be a perfect parent to be a good parent.

text: 你需要的只是爱。
en: All you need is love.

text: 这，就是一家人。
en: That's what you do in a family.

text: 有人靠施暴活着，有人靠挨打才觉得自己还在。
en: Some live by dealing pain; some only feel alive when they take it.

text: 你到底是谁？
en: Who are you?

text: 我只是想相信人。
en: I only wanted to believe in people.

text: 直到面对死亡——我才真正开始活着。
en: Only when facing death did I truly begin to live.

text: 权力最大的时候，人反而消失在阴影里。
en: At the height of power, a man vanishes into shadow.

text: 有时候，正是那些谁也不看好的人，做成了谁也无法想象的事。
en: Sometimes it is the people no one imagines anything of who do the things that no one can imagine.

text: 机器和人不一样，所以想得也不一样。可只因为某样东西跟你想得不一样，就能断定它不在思考吗？
en: Just because something thinks differently from you, does that mean it's not thinking?

text: 你知道人为什么喜欢暴力吗？因为它感觉良好。
en: Do you know why people like violence? It is because it feels good.

text: 我是无辜的！
en: I am an innocent man!

text: 童年是卡在喉咙里的一把刀。不容易拔出来。
en: Childhood is a knife stuck in your throat. It can't be easily removed.

text: 一个想法就像病毒，有韧性，极具传染力。
en: An idea is like a virus. Resilient. Highly contagious.

text: 亲爱的，做梦不妨做得再大一点。
en: You mustn't be afraid to dream a little bigger, darling.

text: 你要跳下信仰之跃，还是变成一个满怀悔恨、等待孤独死去的老人？
en: Do you want to take a leap of faith, or become an old man, filled with regret, waiting to die alone?

text: 回来吧——我们再一起做年轻人。
en: Come back and we'll be young men together again.

text: 等人人都成了超人……就谁也不是超人了。
en: And when everyone's super… no one will be.

text: 我从不回头看，亲爱的——那会分散对「当下」的注意力。
en: I never look back, dahling. It distracts from the now.

text: 不许披风！
en: NO CAPES!

text: 我的战衣呢？
en: Where is my super suit?

text: 出来混，迟早是要还的。
en: If you enter the underworld, sooner or later you have to pay.

text: 给我个机会。我以前没得选——现在，我想做个好人。
对不起，我是警察。
最艰难的选择，需要最坚强的意志。
en: The hardest choices require the strongest wills.

text: 我是必然。
en: I am inevitable.

text: 你应该瞄着头打。
en: You should have gone for the head.

text: 如果我告诉你未来——未来就不会发生。
en: If I tell you what happens, it won't happen.

text: 女人要活下去，就得像昆虫一样往前爬。
en: To stay alive, a woman has to keep crawling forward like an insect.

text: 带她去月球看看。
en: Take her to the moon for me.

text: 哭泣能让我慢下来，好好掂量人生难题的重量。
en: Crying helps me slow down and obsess over the weight of life's problems.

text: 谁是那个爱玩的朋友呀？
en: Who's your friend who likes to play?

text: 爱是唯一能超越时间与空间的力量。
en: Love is the one thing we're capable of perceiving that transcends dimensions of time and space.

text: 不要温和地走进那个良夜。
en: Do not go gentle into that good night.

text: 我们曾仰望星空，思考自己在群星中的位置；如今我们只会低头，担心自己在泥土里的位置。
en: We used to look up at the sky and wonder at our place in the stars. Now we just look down and worry about our place in the dirt.

text: 我的机器人殖民地添了好多奴隶。
en: Plenty of slaves for my robot colony.

text: 幸福只有与人分享时才是真实的。
en: Happiness is only real when shared.

text: 生命的喜悦并不主要来自人与人的关系，你若这么想就错了。
en: You are wrong if you think that the joy of life comes principally from the joy of human relationships.

text: 当你原谅，你就爱了；当你爱了，上帝的光就照在你身上。
en: When you forgive, you love. And when you love, God's light shines upon you.

text: 我真正的残疾，不是坐在轮椅上，而是没有她的世界。
en: My true disability isn't the wheelchair — it's living without her.

text: 你以为你以为的，就是你以为的吗？
en: Are you sure that what you think you think is what you think?

text: 你是谁，由你自己选择。
en: You are who you choose to be.

text: 超人。
en: Superman.

text: 我们创造自己的恶魔。
en: We create our own demons.

text: 真相是……我就是钢铁侠。
en: The truth is... I am Iron Man.

text: 有时候你得先学会跑——再学会走。
en: Sometimes you gotta run before you can walk.

text: 别浪费你的生命。
en: Don't waste your life.

text: 时间摧毁一切。
en: Time destroys all things.

text: 耶利哥的墙——塌了。
en: The walls of Jericho are toppling!

text: 我证明了一件事：胳膊，到底比大拇指强。
en: I proved once and for all that the limb is mightier than the thumb.

text: 看着我的眼睛。你认识我的。
en: Look into my eyes. You know who I am.

text: 你们需要一艘更大的船。
en: You're gonna need a bigger boat.

text: 笑一个，你这狗娘养的——
en: Smile, you son of a—

text: 这不是船的事故。
en: This was no boat accident.

text: 重复到极致的家务，会在某一秒忽然不再听话。
en: Housework repeated to its limit will, in one second, suddenly stop obeying.

text: 像我父亲一样——我是绝地武士。
en: I am a Jedi, like my father before me.

text: 对我来说，已经太迟了，儿子。
en: It is too late for me, son.

text: 你已经救了我，卢克。
en: You already have, Luke.

text: 你一说「你好」，我就已经心动了。
en: You had me at "hello."

text: 让我看到钱！
en: Show me the money!

text: 开足马力，撞沉吉野！
en: Full speed ahead — ram and sink the Yoshino!

text: 吾辈从军卫国——早置生死于度外。
你把我当成了人，可我其实是狼。
en: You thought I was human — but I am the wolf.

text: 男也好，女也好，我只知道我中意你。
en: Man or woman—doesn't matter. I only know I love you.

text: 我不怕死，我生来就是要死的。
en: I am not afraid of death. I was born to die.

text: 我曾以为我的人生是部悲剧，现在我明白了——它是部喜剧。
en: I used to think that my life was a tragedy, but now I realize it's a comedy.

text: 有精神疾病最糟的是：所有人都要你装作没病。
en: The worst part of having a mental illness is people expect you to behave as if you don't.

text: 我只希望我的死，比我的生更值钱。
en: I just hope my death makes more cents than my life.

text: 我们像两个陌生人。
en: We're like two strangers.

text: 一个人若在明知真相后仍保持沉默，他就选择了站在错误的一边。
en: A man who, knowing the truth, remains silent has chosen to stand on the wrong side.

text: 有的人不是被爱选中，是被自由拖着跑。
en: Some are not chosen by love — they are dragged along by freedom.

text: 精灵告诉我：你也可以自由。
en: The spirits tell me: you too can be free.

text: 那可不是一块写字板——这一笔，可擦不掉了，伙计。
en: That ain't no Etch A Sketch. This is one doodle that can't be undid, homeskillet.

text: 所有的宝宝都想被生下来！
en: All babies want to get born born!

text: 生命自会找到出路。
en: Life finds a way.

text: 你们的科学家满脑子都是「能不能做到」，却从没停下来想想「该不该做」。
en: Your scientists were so preoccupied with whether or not they could, they didn't stop to think if they should.

text: 我讨厌自己总是对的。
en: I hate being right all the time.

text: 它们真的成群活动。
en: They do move in herds.

text: 我没有垮掉。而且，我并不孤单。
en: I'm not broken. And I'm not alone.

text: 影子也有影子的命运。
en: Even a shadow has its own fate.

text: 我生下来就是为了活着啊！
en: I was born to live!

text: 没有出路。
en: There is no way out.

text: 我们都曾是孩子，只是后来学会了服从。
en: We were all children once; later, we learned to obey.

text: 可可西里太大了——添一条命或少一条命，它都不在乎。
en: Kekexili is too vast—one life more or less means nothing to it.

text: 你见过磕长头的人吗？他们的脸和手都很脏——可他们的心，特别干净。
我想让它飞。
en: I want to let it fly.

text: 父亲不来，单车还在；有人愿意等你，路就还通。
en: Father may not come — the bike remains; if someone will wait for you, the road stays open.

text: 拳台和黑道两条路，都没能把我们送回教室。
en: Neither the ring nor the underworld ever brought us back to the classroom.

text: 魔女的能力，有时候会消失——但心在，就能再飞起来。
en: We fly with our spirit. When that fades, so does our magic—until the heart finds it again.

text: 有我在，别怕。
en: I'm here. Don't be afraid.

text: 复仇是一道凉菜——冷着吃最好。
en: Revenge is a dish best served cold.

text: 复仇从来不是一条直线。
en: Revenge is never a straight line.

text: 砰。
en: Bang.

text: 我的眼睛，只留给重要的人。
en: I save my eyes only for those who matter.

text: 当一晚的国王，也不要一辈子做个笨蛋。
en: Better to be king for a night than schmuck for a lifetime.

text: 变脸的绝活，只传男不传女。
en: The secret of face-changing is passed only to males.

text: 爷爷，你别丢下我！
美国佬殖民了我们的潜意识。
en: The Yankees have colonized our subconscious.

text: 明礼方能成人。
en: Manners maketh man.

text: 西装是现代绅士的盔甲。
en: The suit is the modern gentleman's armour.

text: 牛津鞋，不要布洛克雕花。
en: Oxfords, not Brogues.

text: 我们要在这儿站一整天呢，还是开打？
en: Now, are we going to stand around here all day, or are we going to fight?

text: 如果我们到不了……记住我。
en: If we don't, remember me.

text: 真正无私的举动，总会点燃另一个。
en: A true selfless act always sparks another.

text: 失衡的生活。
en: Life out of balance.

text: 没有什么秘方。秘方就是你自己。
en: There is no secret ingredient. It's just you.

text: 昨天是历史，明天是谜团，只有今天是天赐的礼物——所以才叫「现在」（present）。
en: Yesterday is history, tomorrow is a mystery, but today is a gift. That is why it is called the present.

text: 人往往在逃避命运的路上，撞见自己的命运。
en: One often meets his destiny on the road he takes to avoid it.

text: 还有谁！
en: Anyone else?!

text: 还有王法吗？还有法律吗？
想学啊？我教你啊。
被蹂躏的人若化作猫，复仇便不再讲人间道理。
en: When the violated return as cats, revenge no longer answers to human reason.

text: 疯狂……疯狂……战争就是这样。
en: Madness! Madness!

text: 我都做了什么？
en: What have I done?

text: 在你们的工作里快乐吧。
en: Be happy in your work.

text: 怪谈里最可怕的，不是鬼，是把誓言当成风。
en: What is most frightening in a ghost story is not the ghost — it is treating a vow like wind.

text: 我不知道你对我做了什么，但我爱你。
en: I don’t know what you do to me, but I love you.

text: 不公开，不留记录，绝对保密。
en: Off the record, on the QT, and very hush-hush.

text: 到目前为止，一切顺利。
en: So far, so good.

text: 恨，招来恨！
en: La haine attire la haine!

text: 一整夜的派对，说不清爱是何时冷却的。
en: A whole night of parties, and no one can say when love went cold.

text: 石头也有用处。万事万物都有用。
en: Everything has a purpose — even a pebble.

text: 敬那些做梦的人——哪怕看起来愚蠢。
en: Here's to the ones who dream, foolish as they may seem.

text: 人们爱的，正是别人身上那份热爱。
en: People love what other people are passionate about.

text: 你这么守旧，还谈什么当革命者？
en: How are you gonna be a revolutionary if you're such a traditionalist?

text: 我会一直爱你。
en: I'm always gonna love you.

text: 你好，克拉丽斯。
en: Hello, Clarice.

text: 有个人口调查员曾想试探我。我把他的肝吃了，配蚕豆，还有一支上好的基安蒂酒。
en: A census taker once tried to test me. I ate his liver with some fava beans and a nice Chianti.

text: 真想多聊一会儿——不过我要和一位老朋友共进晚餐了。
en: I do wish we could chat longer, but I'm having an old friend for dinner.

text: 等价交换，克拉丽斯。
en: Quid pro quo, Clarice.

text: 回到第一性。简单。读马可·奥勒留。对每一件具体的事都要问：它本身是什么？它的本性是什么？
en: First principles, Clarice. Simplicity. Read Marcus Aurelius. Of each particular thing ask: what is it in itself? What is its nature?

text: 军备不起，则根深叶茂。
en: Arms grow weak, while roots grow deep.

text: 人不能离开土地生活。
别偷偷摸摸的——海盗就该堂堂正正地偷！
他选错了。
en: He chose poorly.

text: 你必须选择——但要明智地选。
en: You must choose. But choose wisely.

text: 我们把狗取名叫印第安纳。
en: We named the dog Indiana.

text: X 从来、从来不会标记藏宝点。
en: X never, ever marks the spot.

text: 皇上是世上最寂寞的孩子。
en: The Emperor is the loneliest boy on Earth.

text: 开门！
en: Open the door!

text: 我们来此，只为把名字留在门外。
en: We come here to leave our names outside the door.

text: 我没有结婚的打算。
en: I have no intention of marrying.

text: 诀窍是——不在乎它疼。
en: The trick, William Potter, is not minding that it hurts.

text: 一切皆无定数。
en: Nothing is written.

text: 没有人是无辜的。
en: No one is innocent.

text: 佛祖在地上画了一个红圈，说：当素不相识的人在此相逢，红圈便告完成。
en: The Buddha drew a circle with a piece of red chalk and said: when men, even unknowingly, are to meet one day, they will inevitably come together to accomplish the great Circle of their destiny.

text: 没有比武士更孤独的东西，也许只有丛林里的老虎。
en: There is no greater solitude than that of the samurai, unless perhaps that of the tiger in the jungle.

text: 杜德自有道理。
en: The Dude abides.

text: 你跑题了，唐尼！
en: You're out of your element, Donny!

text: 那张地毯真是把整个房间串起来了。
en: That rug really tied the room together.

text: 那是你的看法而已，哥们。
en: Yeah, well, that's just, like, your opinion, man.

text: 斯莫基，这里不是越南，这是保龄球。这儿有规矩。
en: Smokey, this is not Nam. This is bowling. There are rules.

text: 人生总是这么痛苦吗？还是只有童年如此？
en: Is life always this hard, or is it just when you're a kid?

text: 总是如此。
en: Always like this.

text: 不杀女人，不杀小孩。
en: No women, no kids.

text: 它是我最好的朋友。永远开心，不问问题。
en: It's my best friend. Always happy. No questions.

text: 若要一切如故，就必须让一切改变。
en: If we want things to stay as they are, everything will have to change.

text: 我们是豹，是狮。取代我们的将是豺狼与绵羊——而我们这些豹、豺、绵羊，还会照样自以为是社会中坚。
en: We were the leopards, the lions. Those who take our place will be jackals and sheep. And the whole lot of us — leopards, jackals and sheep — will keep thinking ourselves the salt of the earth.

text: 当我立大地根基的时候，你在哪里？
en: Where were you when I laid the foundations of the earth?

text: 先生，这就是西部。当传说变成事实，就刊登传说。
en: This is the West, sir. When the legend becomes fact, print the legend.

text: 烈日下谁都想自保，心却被烤得越来越硬。
en: Under the scorching sun everyone wants to save themselves — and the heart bakes harder.

text: 为了你，我愿意天天都是生日。
en: For you, every day can be a birthday.

text: 早安，公主！
en: Buongiorno, Principessa!

text: 哭鼻子、想吃点心、想见妈妈的，都要扣分出局。
en: If you cry, if you ask for a snack, if you want to see your mama, you lose points.

text: 这是我的故事。这是我父亲所作的牺牲，这是父亲赐我的恩典。
en: This is my story. This is the sacrifice my father made. This was his gift to me.

text: 你们每个人都是独立的个体。
en: You’re all individuals.

text: 罗马人到底为我们做过什么？
en: What have the Romans ever done for us?

text: 他不是弥赛亚——他只是个很淘气的男孩。
en: He was not the Messiah. He was a very naughty boy.

text: 永远看到生活的光明面。
en: Always look on the bright side of life.

text: 你更喜欢哪一个故事？
en: Which story do you prefer?

text: 信仰是一座有许多房间的房子。
en: Faith is a house with many rooms.

text: 人生就是不断放手，最难受的，是没能好好道别。
en: All of life is an act of letting go, but what hurts the most is not taking a moment to say goodbye.

text: 弹断一千根弦，就能看到这个世界。
en: Break a thousand strings, and you will see the world.

text: 你干吗把豆子都抖出来了？
en: Why'd ya spill yer beans?

text: 你就喜欢我的龙虾。说！
en: Yer fond of me lobster. Say it!

text: 该死的！让尼普顿劈死你吧，温斯洛！
en: DAMN ye! Let Neptune strike ye dead, Winslow!

text: 血缘很重要，但陪伴的时间更重要。
en: Blood matters — but time spent together matters more.

text: 记住你是谁。
en: Remember who you are.

text: 国王的统治，像太阳一样有升有落。
en: A king's time as ruler rises and falls like the sun.

text: 哈库纳玛塔塔！
en: Hakuna Matata!

text: 看看你的内心，辛巴——你比现在的你更伟大。
en: Look inside yourself, Simba. You are more than what you have become.

text: 自己做的饭，吃着最踏实。
en: Food you cook yourself always sits the steadiest.

text: 无论冬春，土地都会给出答案。
en: Winter or spring, the land always answers back.

text: 怕原子弹的人，难道比不怕的人更疯？
en: Is the man who fears the bomb more mad than those who do not?

text: 这是送给我的。
en: This is for me.

text: 这是个美丽的地方。
en: It is a beautiful place.

text: 枪是唬人的，刀子才是专业的。
en: Guns for show, knives for a pro.

text: 你知道「报应」是什么意思吗？
en: Do you know what 'nemesis' means?

text: 这买卖简直是抢——世纪大甩卖。
en: It's a deal, it's a steal, it's the sale of the fuckin' century.

text: 自然让我成为怪物，人类让我成为武器，而上帝让我活得太久。
en: Nature made me a freak. Man made me a weapon. And God made it last too long.

text: 原来这就是这种感觉。
en: So this is what it feels like.

text: 别成为他们造出来的东西。
en: Don't be what they made you.

text: 这里的人有私生活，也有公共生活，两者毫不相干。
en: The people here have a private life and a public life, and the two have nothing to do with each other.

text: 只要我还相信他活着，战争就还没真正结束。
en: As long as I believe he lives, the war is not truly over for me.

text: 地球上每十二人就有一支枪。问题只剩：怎么把另外十一个人也武装起来？
en: There's one firearm for every twelve people on the planet. The only question is: How do we arm the other eleven?

text: 人们说：好人袖手旁观，邪恶就会横行。他们其实该说：邪恶总会横行。
en: They say evil prevails when good men fail to act. What they should say is: evil prevails.

text: 我可以告诉你——不过那得收费。
en: I would tell you, but then I'd have to charge you.

text: 没有坏人，只有坏的环境。
en: There are no bad people, only bad circumstances.

text: 天涯海角，也要找到你。
en: To the ends of the earth — I will still find you.

text: 偷走孩子的梦，是因为自己再也梦不着。
en: He steals children's dreams because he can no longer dream.

text: 就这样吧，现在。
en: For now.

text: 你越清楚自己是谁、想要什么，就越不容易被事情搅扰。
en: The more you know who you are and what you want, the less you let things upset you.

text: 人生最吓人的一天，是第一个孩子出生的那天。
en: The most terrifying day of your life is the day the first one is born.

text: 一杯太多，一百杯又不够。
en: One drink is too many, and a hundred drinks are not enough.

text: 我不是在喝酒的人——我是酒鬼。
en: I'm not a drinker. I'm a drunk.

text: 对我来说，你是完美的。
en: To me, you are perfect.

text: 我们是小国——但也是伟大的国家。
en: We may be a small country, but we're a great one too.

text: 我爱你。这句话，比任何教义都重。
en: I love you — that weighs more than any doctrine.

text: 请问，有没有一位叫藤井树的同学？
en: Excuse me, is there a student named Fujii Tree in your class?

text: 你还好吗？——我很好！
en: Genki desu ka? Watashi wa genki desu.

text: 快走。
en: Go. Now.

text: 我控制不了自己！……我没有别的路可走——我必须走这条路！
en: I can't help myself! I have no control over this evil thing that's inside of me—the fire, the voices, the torment!

text: 我们不是物件。
en: We are not things.

text: 多好的一天啊！
en: What a lovely day!

text: 希望是一种错误。修不好破掉的东西，人就会疯。
en: Hope is a mistake. If you can't fix what's broken, you'll go insane.

text: 朋友们，别对水上瘾。它会攫住你，失去时你会怨愤。
en: Do not, my friends, become addicted to water. It will take hold of you, and you will resent its absence.

text: 我叫麦克斯。我的世界是火与血。
en: My name is Max. My world is fire and blood.

text: 还没呢！
en: Not yet!

text: 我们也许会从过去中走出来，但过去不会放过我们。
en: We may be through with the past, but the past is not through with us.

text: 妻子出门上班的那天，家里的天平就开始晃。
en: The day the wife goes out to work, the household scales begin to tip.

text: 她只是想做一个普通的女人。
en: She only wanted to be a woman like any other.

text: 我要我的儿子出人头地。
en: I want my son to become somebody.

text: 这是一部关于电影语言的实验：不用剧本、不用布景、不用演员，也不借助字幕。
en: This film is an experiment in cinematic communication of real events without the help of intertitles, without the help of a scenario, without the help of theatre.

text: 我打不过它。我打不过它。
en: I can't beat it. I can't beat it.

text: 我过不去这道坎。我过不去这道坎。对不起。
en: I can't beat it. I can't beat it. I'm sorry.

text: 对人，你总得有一点点信心。
en: You have to have a little faith in people.

text: 第一章。他钟爱纽约。
en: Chapter One. He adored New York City.

text: 战争还没有结束。
en: The war is not over yet.

text: 去年是否发生过，取决于你今夜是否愿意承认。
en: Whether it happened last year depends on whether you will admit it tonight.

text: 在我遇过的所有女孩里，我最喜欢你。
en: Of all the girls I’ve ever met, I like you best.

text: 我想弄清楚我到底是谁。
en: I want to find out who I am.

text: 每天早上醒来，我都盼着你死了——如果我敢保证亨利没事的话。
en: Every day, I wake up and I hope you're dead! Dead, like — if I could guarantee Henry would be okay...

text: 我得用科学，把这该死的局面搞定。
en: I'm going to have to science the shit out of this.

text: 我这下基本完蛋了。
en: I'm pretty much fucked.

text: 解决一个问题，再解决下一个。解决了足够多的问题，你就能回家。
en: You solve one problem, and then you solve the next one. And if you solve enough problems, you get to come home.

text: 谢谢你做我的朋友。
en: Thank you for being my friend.

text: 你是我最好的朋友，我唯一的朋友。
en: You are my best friend. You are my only friend.

text: 你难道不知道，在军中总要两害相权取其轻——在两只象鼻虫里挑小的那只？
en: Do you not know that in the service one must always choose the lesser of two weevils?

text: 世上本没有勺子。
en: There is no spoon.

text: 我只能给你看门在哪——走过去的，只能是你自己。
en: I can only show you the door. You're the one that has to walk through it.

text: 知道路，和走路，是两回事。
en: There's a difference between knowing the path and walking the path.

text: 无知是福。
en: Ignorance is bliss.

text: 永远别让人类去干机器的活。
en: Never send a human to do a machine's job.

text: 你不是来做选择的——你已经选好了。你来，是为了理解自己为什么这样选。
en: You didn't come here to make the choice. You've already made it. You're here to understand why you made it.

text: 希望——这是人类最典型的妄想。它既是人类最强大的力量，也是最大的弱点。
en: Hope. It is the quintessential human delusion... the source of your enduring strength and weakness.

text: 选择是幻觉——由有权者与无权者共同制造的幻觉。
en: Choice is an illusion, created between those with power and those without.

text: 因为我选择如此。
en: Because I choose to.

text: 这是必然。
en: It is inevitable.

text: 有开始的东西，就有结束，尼奥。
en: Everything that has a beginning has an end, Neo.

text: 能活着，真好。
en: I'm glad I was alive.

text: 没有什么比引力定律更强大。
en: Nothing is stronger than the law of gravity.

text: 信念若怕偶然，也就怕了整个夜晚。
en: If faith fears chance, it also fears the whole night.

text: 他们想买下这里的一切。
en: They want to buy everything here.

text: 我心里有诗。
en: I've got poetry in me!

text: 如果说拳击里有魔法，那是超越耐力、超越断肋、破裂肾脏和脱落视网膜去打仗的魔法。是为了一个只有你看得见的梦，把一切押上去的魔法。
