en: If there's magic in boxing, it's the magic of fighting battles beyond endurance, beyond cracked ribs, ruptured kidneys and detached retinas. It's the magic of risking everything for a dream that nobody sees but you.

text: 永远保护你自己。
en: Always protect yourself.

text: 你不会在教堂里赎罪，你得在街上赎罪。
en: You don’t make up for your sins in church; you do it in the streets.

text: 别再坚持了！没用的！再也没有什么可能了！
en: Don't keep insisting! It's useless! Nothing is possible anymore!

text: 记忆会改变房间的形状，也会改变车的颜色。记忆可以被扭曲——它们只是一种解释，不是记录。
en: Memory can change the shape of a room; it can change the color of a car. And memories can be distorted. They're just an interpretation, they're not a record.

text: 我必须相信我头脑之外还有一个世界。我必须相信我的行为仍有意义——哪怕我记不住它们。
en: I have to believe in a world outside my own mind. I have to believe that my actions still have meaning, even if I can't remember them.

text: 为了快乐，我会骗自己吗？就你而言，泰迪——会的。
en: Do I lie to myself to be happy? In your case, Teddy, yes I will.

text: 你在看什么？
en: What are you looking at?

text: 我还没有学会适应这场革命。
en: I still haven’t learned how to adapt to this revolution.

text: 战俘营里说一声圣诞快乐，比投降更危险。
en: In a POW camp, saying Merry Christmas can be more dangerous than surrender.

text: 圣诞快乐，劳伦斯先生。
en: Merry Christmas, Mr. Lawrence.

text: 头脑与双手之间，必须有心灵来做调解。
en: The mediator between the head and the hands must be the heart!

text: 我一直在追他——穿越每部戏、每个时代。
en: I've always been chasing him—through every role, every era.

text: 这一次——这一次我觉得一定能见到他。
这是爸爸送给你的礼物。
en: This is Daddy's present for you.

text: 一切尚未过去。
en: All is not yet past.

text: 我是你的头号书迷。
en: I'm your number one fan.

text: 他没能从那辆破车里出来！
en: He didn't get out of the COCKADOODIE CAR!

text: 你杀了我的米瑟莉！
en: You killed my Misery!

text: 我想知道我的儿子发生了什么。
en: I want to know what happened to my son.

text: 美好的事物，从不主动吸引注意。
en: Beautiful things don't ask for attention.

text: 开拓视野，冲破艰险，看见世界，身临其境，贴近彼此，感受生活——这就是生活的目的。
en: To see the world, things dangerous to come to, to see behind walls, draw closer, to find each other, and to feel. That is the purpose of life.

text: 你永远无法真正理解一个人——除非你钻进他的皮肤里走上一圈。
en: You never really understand a person until you consider things from his point of view... until you climb into his skin and walk around in it.

text: 世上唯一不服从多数表决的东西，是一个人的良心。
en: The one thing that doesn't abide by majority rule is a person's conscience.

text: 真正的勇气是：明知一开始就输定了，还是照样开始，并且坚持到底。
en: Real courage is when you know you're licked before you begin, but you begin anyway and you see it through no matter what.

text: 斯库特，大多数人都是这样的——等你真正了解他们的时候。
en: Most people are, Scout, when you finally see them.

text: 微笑吧。
en: Smile.

text: 咱们能挺过去的。
en: We'll get along!

text: 皇帝轮流做，明年到我家！
en: Emperors take turns, and next year it will be mine!

text: 活着。即使被诅咒，也要好好地活着。
en: Live. Even if you are cursed, live.

text: 都看好了——我来示范，怎么杀掉一个神。
毕竟，这是假期。
en: After all, it’s the holidays.

text: 到底谁才是怪物？
en: Who is the monster, really?

text: 我们吓人，是因为我们在乎。
en: We scare because we care.

text: 为了不让这家公司倒闭，我可以绑架一千个孩子！
en: I'll kidnap a thousand children before I let this company die!

text: 那些消逝了的岁月，仿佛隔着一块积着灰尘的玻璃，看得到，抓不着。
en: The vanished years are like looking through dusty glass—you can see them, but you can't catch them.

text: 如果我多一张船票——你会不会跟我一起走？
我们不会跟他们一样的。
每个人都只能陪你走一段路，迟早是要分开的。
en: Everyone can only walk with you for a stretch — sooner or later, you part.

text: 要不我们跳过跳舞，直接进入我杀你的环节？
en: How about we just skip the dancing and get right to the part where I kill you?

text: 有些失败的事业，才是唯一值得为之奋斗的事业。
en: Sometimes lost causes are the only causes worth fighting for.

text: 自由太珍贵了，不能只埋在书里……人应该每天把它举到眼前，对自己说：我有自由去思考、去说话。
en: Liberty's too precious a thing to be buried in books... Men should hold it up in front of them every single day of their lives and say: I'm free to think and to speak.

text: 没有乐队。
en: There is no band.

text: 就是这个女孩。
en: This is the girl.

text: 这家店后面坐着一个人。我做的噩梦，都是因为他。
en: There's a man in the back of this place. He's the reason I'm having nightmares.

text: 有一天我们会离开这里。不是逃走，是出发。
en: One day we'll leave this place — not fleeing, but setting out.

text: 一个世纪有两副面孔，像一对孪生的女儿。
en: A century has two faces — like a pair of twin daughters.

text: 日子难过啊。
en: These days are hard to get through.

text: 我们把罪孽埋在这儿，戴夫。把它们洗干净。
en: We bury our sins here, Dave. We wash them clean.

text: 那里面——是我女儿吗？
en: Is that my daughter in there?

text: 艺伎馆的水一直在流，人走了，规矩还在。
en: Water keeps flowing through the geisha house — people leave, the rules remain.

text: 人类注定要灭亡。
en: The human race is doomed.

text: 我们还是人。
en: We are still human.

text: 活着比死更艰难吧。
纳努克，无畏的猎人。
en: Nanook, the fearless hunter.

text: 山在等着我。
en: The mountain is waiting for me.

text: 这不会让我烦恼。
en: It don't worry me.

text: 我们要活下去。
en: We must live.

text: 我气疯了——我再也不打算忍受下去了！
en: I'm as mad as hell, and I'm not going to take this anymore!

text: 关掉你们的电视机。
en: Turn off your televisions.

text: 这个世界就是一门生意。
en: The world is a business.

text: 我要活，我要活下去！
en: I want to live — I want to go on living!

text: 新世界的门一旦打开，就再也关不上了。
en: Once the door to the new world opens, it never closes again.

text: 老幺，一定要守住咱们的人。
我一人做事一人当，不许你们祸害别人！
en: I alone did the deed—I alone will bear it. You will not harm anyone else!

text: 爹爹！你的骨肉我还给你，我不连累你！
骗子之间也讲信任。
en: Among thieves, it’s based on trust.

text: 你在一次抛硬币上，最多输过多少？
en: What's the most you ever lost on a coin toss?

text: 如果你所遵循的规则把你带到了这里，那这规则还有什么用？
en: If the rule you followed brought you to this, of what use was the rule?

text: 叫吧，伙计。
en: Call it, friendo.

text: 妈妈说过，绝对不能跟任何人说我们的事。
en: Mom said we must never tell anyone about us.

text: 在广告的世界里，没有谎言这回事——只有权宜的夸张。
en: In the world of advertising, there's no such thing as a lie. There's only expedient exaggeration.

text: 我是广告人——不是一条熏鲱鱼。
en: I'm an advertising man, not a red herring.

text: 他夜里来，他夜里走。
en: He comes by night, and by night he goes.

text: 故乡与流放之间，没有真正的区别。
en: There is no real difference between home and exile.

text: 如果你是鸟，那我也是鸟。
en: If you're a bird, I'm a bird.

text: 我是个普通人，想法普通，过得平凡。但有一件事我做到了极致：我全心全意爱过一个人。对我而言，这就足够了。
en: I am nothing special, of this I am sure... But in one respect I have succeeded as gloriously as anyone who's ever lived: I've loved another with all my heart and soul, and for me, that has always been enough.

text: 这不容易，会非常难。我们得每天面对彼此。但我想要这样——因为我想要你。我要全部的你，永远，每一天。
en: So it's not gonna be easy. It's gonna be really hard... But I wanna do that, because I want you. I want all of you, forever, every day.

text: 我们同一天出生。
en: We were born on the same day.

text: 这里就是我的家。
en: This is my home.

text: 最暖的，常常是错过的。
en: What feels warmest is often what we missed.

text: 你有天赋，你有力量。而能力越大，责任越大。
en: You have a gift. You have power. And with great power, there must also come great responsibility.

text: 如果你能帮别人做点好事，你就有道义责任去做。
en: If you could do good things for other people, you had a moral obligation to do those things.

text: 就算别人觉得恶心，我也要爱。
en: Even if others find it disgusting, I will love.

text: 键盘有始有终，你却永远无法预知船外的世界有多大。
en: The keyboard has a beginning and an end. You never know what's out there beyond the boat.

text: 陆地对我来说，是一艘太大的船。
en: La terra è una nave troppo grande per me.

text: 对不起，戴夫。恐怕我不能那样做。
en: I'm sorry, Dave. I'm afraid I can't do that.

text: 你到底想干什么，戴夫？
en: Just what do you think you're doing, Dave?

text: 打开舱门，HAL。
en: Open the pod bay doors, HAL.

text: 我想知道真相。
en: I want to know the truth.

text: 女人的一生，常常不是自己选的路。
en: A woman's life is so often a road she did not choose.

text: 一个人可以改一切：脸、房子、家庭、女友、宗教，甚至上帝——但有一样他改不了：改不了激情。
en: A guy can change everything—his face, his home, his family, his girlfriend, his religion, even his God. But there's one thing he can't change: he can't change his passion.

text: 把逝者送上旅途，是为了让生者继续前行。
en: We send the dead on their way so the living can go on.

text: 爸爸的花儿落了，我也不再是小孩子。
en: Father's flowers have fallen, and I am no longer a child.

text: 长亭外，古道边，芳草碧连天。
井，一定要打出来。
en: The well must be dug — no matter what.

text: 就算哭得撕心裂肺——也请活下去。
en: Even if you cry your heart out—please live on.

text: 偷得到宝石，偷不走兄弟。
en: You can steal a jewel; you can't steal a brother.

text: 我女儿在电影里，我来看我女儿。
en: My daughter is in the film — I came to see my daughter.

text: 只要活着，就不能停下来。
en: As long as we live, we cannot stop.

text: 长大以后，我还想做小时候真正想做的事吗？
en: Grown up — do I still want what the child in me truly wanted?

text: 现在我成了死神，世界的毁灭者。
en: Now I am become Death, the destroyer of worlds.

text: 他们不会害怕，直到理解它；他们不会理解，直到用过它。
en: They won't fear it until they understand it. And they won't understand it until they've used it.

text: 业余的人追着太阳跑，然后被吃掉。权力待在阴影里。
en: Amateurs seek the sun. Get eaten. Power stays in the shadows.

text: 我相信——已经发生了。
en: I believe we did.

text: 我相信上帝。
en: I believe in God.

text: 重要的是保持不朽。
en: The important thing is to remain immortal.

text: 看看我的人生。三十四岁了，我一无所有。
en: Look at my life. I’m 34 years old. I’ve got nothing.

text: 四季会来，人也会来——有些人会留下来。
en: Seasons come, people come—and some of them stay.

text: 你永远逃不掉。
en: You can never get away from it.

text: 我从来只在夜里见她。我们好像一直活在阴影里。
en: I never saw her in the daytime. We seemed to live by night.

text: 给我搭好绞架吧，宝贝。
en: Build my gallows high, baby.

text: 规矩破了，人也就废了。
en: Once the code is broken, the man is finished.

text: 我本来准备好去死了。可你们非让我活着。
en: I was ready to die. Then you people made me stay alive.

text: 解放不是一条直线，是六段还来不及互相认识的善意。
en: Liberation is not a straight line — it is six chapters of goodwill that never quite meet.

text: 他们叫我纯洁，却不许我走进纯洁的门槛。
en: They name me pure — yet forbid me to cross the threshold of purity.

text: 活着，就是一场赌局。
en: Living is a gamble.

text: 我不是坏女人，我只是想快乐。
en: I am not a bad woman — I only want to be happy.

text: 据说公主回到了父亲的王国，以公正与善良统治了许多世纪；她在人间留下的痕迹，只有知道往哪里看的人才能看见。
en: And it is said that the Princess returned to her father's kingdom... and that she left behind small traces of her time on Earth, visible only to those who know where to look.

text: 梦是会传染的。
en: Dreams are contagious.

text: 天堂若要用尸体铺路，那还是不是天堂？
en: If paradise is paved with corpses, is it still paradise?

text: 生活不像电影，生活要艰难得多。
en: Life isn't like in the movies. Life... is much harder.

text: 别回来。别想我们。别回头。别写信。别向乡愁投降。
en: Don't come back. Don't think of us. Don't look back. Don't write. Don't give in to nostalgia.

text: 你知道什么计划不会失败吗？没有计划。
en: You know what kind of plan never fails? No plan at all.

text: 她有钱，还这么善良。要是我有钱，我也会善良。钱就是熨斗——把一切褶皱都熨平了。
en: She's rich, but still kind. If I were rich, I would be kind too. Money is an iron; it smooths out all the creases.

text: 今天我立了一个计划——一个根本性的计划。我要赚很多钱，买下这栋房子……到那时，爸爸就会光明正大地走上台阶，从前门进来。
en: Father. Today I made a plan — a fundamental plan... Then my father will walk up the steps and come through the front door.

text: 公路尽头不是家，是一张还没说完的口信。
en: At the end of the highway is not home — it is a message still unfinished.

text: 我认识两个人。这两个人——曾经相爱。
en: I knew these people. These two people. They were in love with each other.

text: 人每天都在消失；有时是自己把自己换掉。
en: People disappear every day — sometimes by trading themselves away.

text: 悲伤和欢乐总是相伴而来。
en: Sorrow and joy always arrive together.

text: 先生们，有些时候我为自己身为人类而感到羞耻——此刻正是其一。
en: Gentlemen of the court, there are times when I'm ashamed to be a member of the human race and this is one such occasion.

text: 和平若只靠忘记危险来维持，那它随时会碎。
en: If peace is kept only by forgetting danger, it can shatter at any moment.

text: 正义与战争其实很像：昨天还是正义的东西，不知不觉就成了战争；昨天还是战争的东西，转眼又成了正义。
大人恋爱时说的谎，小孩在旁边看得一清二楚。
en: The lies adults tell in love are perfectly clear to the child standing beside them.

text: 毕业即失业。
en: Graduate — and immediately unemployed.

text: 我不想杀你，我只是想拍下你害怕的样子。
en: I don’t want to kill you; I only want to film the look of fear.

text: 谁才是真正的我？
en: Who is the real me?

text: 有些秘密，说出来，朋友就做不成了。
en: Some secrets, once spoken, end a friendship.

text: 你前面的路还很长。别浪费。
en: You've got a whole life ahead of you. Don't waste it.

text: 如果我是你爸爸——我们就去阿拉斯加。
en: If I'd have been your dad, we'd have gone to Alaska.

text: 我想——如果我真的努力——我可以变成你。
en: I think I could turn into you if I really tried.

text: 爱会让人变得残忍。
en: Love can make people cruel.

text: 我们每个人心里都有光明与黑暗。要紧的是你选择按哪一边行事。
en: We've all got both light and dark inside us. What matters is the part we choose to act on.

text: 你和我一样清醒。
en: You're just as sane as I am.

text: 世界并不是分成好人和食死徒两半。
en: The world isn't split into good people and Death Eaters.

text: 我是钢琴家。
en: I am a pianist.

text: 谢谢上帝，别谢我。是祂想让我们活下去。
en: Thank God, not me. He wants us to survive.

text: 就叫我查理吧。
en: Just call me Charlie.

text: 你听见的不是我的说话声，而是我的心声。
en: The voice you hear is not my speaking voice, but my mind’s voice.

text: 我让你恶心吗？
en: Do I disgust you?

text: 哦，让娜，为了走到你身边，我竟走了怎样一条奇怪的路。
en: Oh Jeanne, to reach you at last, what a strange path I had to take.

text: 一切都在恰好的时间与地点开始，也结束。
en: Everything begins and ends at exactly the right time and place.

text: 逃向南方的颜色太鲜艳，结局只能用火药收场。
en: The colors of fleeing south are too vivid — the ending can only be settled with gunpowder.

text: 鸽子停在枝上，思考有没有必要存在。
en: A pigeon sat on a branch, reflecting on whether existence is necessary.

text: 很高兴听到你一切都好。
en: I'm happy to hear you're doing fine.

text: 军舰泊在港里，猪就在岸上被人养肥宰杀。
en: While battleships sit in the harbor, pigs ashore are fattened for the knife.

text: 今天，将是你永远记得的日子——差点抓住杰克·斯派洛船长的日子！
en: This is the day you will always remember as the day you almost caught Captain Jack Sparrow!

text: 朗姆酒怎么总是没了？
en: Why is the rum always gone?

text: 你最好开始相信鬼故事，特纳小姐——你现在就在一个里面！
en: You best start believing in ghost stories, Miss Turner... you're in one!

text: 你已经开到地图之外了，伙计。这里有怪物。
en: You're off the edge of the map, mate. Here there be monsters.

text: 这既不是梦，也不是现实。
en: This is neither a dream nor reality.

text: 在街上，你要么学会活下去，要么就消失。
en: On the street, you learn to survive—or you disappear.

text: 时代已经不一样了。
en: The times are already different.

text: 我们没有和敌人战斗；我们是在和自己战斗。
en: We did not fight the enemy; we fought ourselves.

text: 地狱里不好好拍电影，要在哪儿拍？
en: If you won't make a movie in hell, where will you?

text: 每个人都在寻找自己的位置。
en: Everyone is looking for their place.

text: 枪响之后，问题不是「为什么是我」，而是「为什么是这里」。
en: After the shots, the question is not 'why me' — but 'why here'.

text: 不变成人类，我们就活不下去了。
en: If we don’t turn into humans, we won’t survive.

text: 新桥上的烟火再亮，也照不进无家可归的夜晚。
en: Even the fireworks over Pont-Neuf cannot light a night with no home.

text: 波妞喜欢宗介！
en: Ponyo loves Sosuke!

text: 我会保护你的。
与其做法西斯，我宁可做猪。
en: I'd rather be a pig than a fascist.

text: 是不是所有恋人，都觉得自己在发明什么？
en: Do all lovers feel they're inventing something?

text: 诗不属于写它的人，而属于需要它的人。
en: Poetry doesn't belong to those who write it, but to those who need it.

text: 想头，也叫理想。人有想头，就什么都有。
en: What we call hope is also called an ideal. If you have hope, you have everything.

text: 山里人为什么要住在山里呢？——山里人住在山里，就像脚放在鞋里面，舒服。
兄弟们！
en: Brothers!

text: 哈利——你是个巫师。
en: Harry — yer a wizard.

text: 对抗敌人需要巨大的勇气，对抗朋友同样如此。
en: It takes a great deal of bravery to stand up to our enemies, but just as much to stand up to our friends.

text: 你们俩若不介意，我要去睡了——免得你们又想出什么让我们送命的鬼主意，或者更糟：被开除。
en: Now if you two don't mind, I'm going to bed before either of you come up with another clever idea to get us killed — or worse, expelled.

text: 你看仔细了吗？
en: Are you watching closely?

text: 秘密本身不会打动任何人——你用它变出的戏法才是一切。
en: The secret impresses no one. The trick you use it for is everything.

text: 阿布拉卡达布拉。
en: Abracadabra.

text: 你迷惑了我的身心，我爱你。我爱你。我爱你。
en: You have bewitched me, body and soul, and I love, I love, I love you.

text: 我挣扎过，但没有用。我的感情再也压抑不住了。请允许我告诉你——我是多么热烈地爱慕着你。
en: In vain I have struggled. It will not do. My feelings will not be repressed. You must allow me to tell you how ardently I admire and love you.

text: 无论你用哪种方式求婚，都不可能让我接受。
en: You could not have made me the offer of your hand in any possible way that would have tempted me to accept it.

text: 祈求最好的，也要为最坏的做准备。
en: Pray for the best, but prepare for the worst.

text: 在这里想活下去，先学会读懂规则。
en: To survive here, first learn to read the rules.

text: 我们每个人，偶尔都会有一点疯狂。
en: We all go a little mad sometimes.

text: 男孩最好的朋友，是他的母亲。
en: A boy's best friend is his mother.

text: 我们都被困在自己的陷阱里——而且那陷阱从来不会变。
en: We're all in our private traps, clamped in them, and none of us can ever get out. They never really change.

text: 头痛就像决心——不疼了，也就忘了。
en: Headaches are like resolutions. You forget them as soon as they stop hurting.

text: 我在努力，林戈。我在很努力地想当个牧羊人。
en: I'm tryin', Ringo. I'm tryin' real hard to be the shepherd.

text: 我丈夫、你的老板马沙·华莱士，让你带我出来玩个够。现在——我要跳舞。
en: I do believe Marsellus Wallace, my husband, your boss, told you to take me out and do whatever I wanted. Now I wanna dance.

text: 那儿要三十分钟车程。我十分钟到。
en: That's thirty minutes away. I'll be there in ten.

text: 我要对你来一场中世纪式的处置。
en: I'm gonna git medieval on your ass.

text: 连上网络的那一刻，幽灵也找到了入口。
en: The moment you connect, the ghosts find their doorway too.

text: 人生就是一场戏。
en: Life is a play.

text: 银幕里的人走出来以后，现实反而更像一场假戏。
en: Once the man on the screen steps out, reality feels more like a false play.

text: 我不能结婚。
en: I cannot marry.

text: 如果我们不能保护他们，我们还算什么？
en: Who are we if we can't protect them?

text: 我一直都爱你们。
en: I have always loved you.

text: 你没把我打倒，雷。——你从没打倒过我。
en: You never got me down, Ray. You never got me down.

text: 你睡了我老婆？
en: You fuck my wife?

text: 蛇。为什么偏偏是蛇？
en: Snakes. Why did it have to be snakes?

text: 亲爱的，问题不在年头，在里程。
en: It's not the years, honey, it's the mileage.

text: 我也不知道，我都是走一步编一步。
en: I don't know, I'm making this up as I go.

text: 你我很像：考古学就是我们的宗教。只是我们都已背离了更纯粹的信仰。
en: You and I are very much alike. Archaeology is our religion, yet we have both fallen from the purer faith.

text: 我是个出色的司机。
en: I'm an excellent driver.

text: 哦不——还有十五分钟到《人民法庭》。
en: Uh-oh. Fifteen minutes to Wapner.

text: 凯马特糟透了。
en: K-Mart sucks.

text: 我是坏人，那很好。我永远成不了好人，那也不坏。除了做自己，我谁也不想当。
en: I'm bad, and that's good. I will never be good, and that's not bad. There's no one I'd rather be than me.

text: 是他们先见了血，不是我。
en: They drew first blood, not me.

text: 我可以杀光他们，也可以杀掉你。在镇上你代表法律——出了镇子，是我说了算。
en: I could have killed 'em all. I could've killed you. In town you're the law, out here it's me.

text: 没有结束！什么都没有结束！你们说放就放得下——我们放不下！
en: Nothing is over! Nothing! You just don't turn it off!

text: 在这疯狂的世界里——只有疯子才能自由。
en: In a mad world, only the mad are sane.

text: 人，是会说谎的。连对自己，也常常说不了实话。
en: It's human to lie. Most of the time we can't even be honest with ourselves.

text: 不是每个人都能成为伟大的艺术家，但伟大的艺术家可以来自任何地方。
en: Not everyone can become a great artist, but a great artist can come from anywhere.

text: 我们评论家必须面对的苦涩真相是：一件平庸的破烂，可能都比我们给它贴上的批评更有意义。
en: The bitter truth we critics must face is that... the average piece of junk is probably more meaningful than our criticism designating it so.

text: 食欲一旦觉醒，就再也装不成素食者。
en: Once appetite awakens, you can no longer play the vegetarian.

text: 听不见的人，有时比谁都听得清。
en: Those who cannot hear sometimes listen more clearly than anyone.

text: 当分不清真实与节目，现实就成了最长的试镜。
en: When you can no longer tell life from the show, reality becomes the longest audition.

text: 爱到尽头，身体与死亡只剩一张薄纸。
en: At the end of love, the body and death are only a thin sheet apart.

text: 我们都成了偷窥的人。
en: We've become a race of peeping Toms.

text: 人们该做的，是从自己家里走出来——反过来往里看看。
en: What people ought to do is get outside their own house and look in for a change.

text: 昨夜，我又梦见了曼德利。
en: Last night I dreamt I went to Manderley again.

text: 我们再也不能回曼德利了。
en: We can never go back to Manderley again.

text: 要医治一个人，先得理解他的痛苦。
en: To heal a person, you must first understand their pain.

text: 工厂的烟比雾更诚实——它不假装能让人看清彼此。
en: Factory smoke is more honest than fog — it does not pretend to let people see each other.

text: 要翻身，当红军！
en: To change our fate — join the Red Army!

text: 灯一亮，女人的命就被拴在院子里。
en: When the lantern is lit, a woman's fate is tied to the courtyard.

text: 在这个院里，人算什么东西？像狗，像猫，像耗子——唯独就是不像人。
你为什么想跳舞？——你为什么想活着？
en: Why do you want to dance? — Why do you want to live?

text: 依赖人间爱情这可疑慰藉的舞者，永远成不了伟大的舞蹈家。
en: A dancer who relies on the doubtful comforts of human love can never be a great dancer.

text: 人活着，就像高粱酒一样，越烧越烈。
en: Life is like sorghum wine: the more it burns, the stronger it becomes.

text: 巴黎与乡村之间，四则小品刚好够谈完一次友谊。
en: Between Paris and the countryside, four sketches are just enough to finish one friendship.

text: 我现在是个人物了，哈利。大家都喜欢我。
en: I'm somebody now, Harry. Everybody likes me.

text: 我要上电视了。
en: I'm going to be on television.

text: 你是打算汪汪叫一整天，小狗——还是要咬人？
en: Are you gonna bark all day, little doggie, or are you gonna bite?

text: 你敢开枪打他——下一个死的就是你。
en: If you shoot this man, you die next.

text: 照我说的做。
en: Do as I say.

text: 只要还能喘口气，你就得打下去。呼吸。继续呼吸。
en: As long as you can still grab a breath, you fight. You breathe. Keep breathing.

text: 我已经不怕死了——因为我死过一次了。
en: I ain't afraid to die anymore. I've done it already.

text: 原爆的那天，天空比什么都亮。
en: On the day of the bomb, the sky was brighter than anything.

text: 撬开保险柜的那半小时，谁先出声谁就输。
en: In the half hour that cracks the safe, the first to speak has already lost.

text: 这时对，那时错。
en: Right now, wrong then.

text: 有些朋友离开了，也会以另一种方式回来。
en: Some friends leave—and still find another way back.

text: 米兰的光再亮，也洗不掉南方带来的影子。
en: However bright Milan's lights, they cannot wash away the shadow brought from the South.

text: 我不会输——因为我只想撑完全场。
en: I can't lose... 'cause all I wanna do is go the distance.

text: 哟，艾德丽安！
en: Yo Adrian!

text: 放我出去打，米克。
en: Cut me, Mick.

text: 我不坏。我只是被画成这样。
en: I'm not bad. I'm just drawn that way.

text: 笑可以是非常强大的东西。
en: A laugh can be a very powerful thing.

text: 这就是罗马。
en: This is Rome.

text: 我们女人总是独自一人。
en: We women are always alone.

text: 不管他们怎么跟你说——我们女人，总是独自一人。
en: No matter what they tell you, we women are always alone.

text: 我不想要她。
en: No la quería.

text: 我不知道该怎么说再见。我想不出任何话来。
en: I don't know how to say goodbye. I can't think of any words.

text: 罗马。当然是罗马。我会把这段记忆珍藏一辈子。
en: Rome. By all means, Rome. I will cherish my visit here in memory as long as I live.

text: 外面有好多好多地方。
en: There's so much of place in the world.

text: 再见，房间。
en: Goodbye, Room.

text: 我的视界在心里！鸟在这儿歌唱，天在这儿湛蓝！
en: My vision is within! Here is where the birds sing; here is where the sky is blue!

text: 你叫罗塞塔。我叫罗塞塔。你找到了工作。我找到了工作。你有正常的生活。我有正常的生活。
en: Your name is Rosetta. My name is Rosetta. You found a job. I found a job. You have a normal life. I have a normal life.

text: 我的朋友们，你们无需向任何人鞠躬。
en: My friends, you bow to no one.

text: 我背不动它……但我背得动你！
en: I can't carry it for you... but I can carry you!

text: 我不会说「别哭」——因为并非所有眼泪都是苦的。
en: I will not say: do not weep; for not all tears are an evil.

text: 我不是男人。
en: I am no man.

text: 起来吧，起来吧，希优顿的骑士们！冲锋！为了毁灭，为了世界的终结，冲锋！
en: Arise, arise, Riders of Théoden! ... Ride for ruin and the world's ending!

text: 五十年后再见，胭脂还在，人已不是那个人。
en: Fifty years later the rouge remains — the person does not.

text: 十二少，多谢你还记得我。这个胭脂扣，我戴了五十三年——现在还给你，我不再等了。
牢房的墙，比鞭子更会说话。
en: The walls of the prison speak louder than the whip.

text: 人们来绿洲，是为了能做的事；留下，是为了能成为的人。
en: People come to the OASIS for all the things they can do, but they stay for all the things they can be.

text: 谢谢你玩我的游戏。
en: Thank you for playing my game.

text: 同为粉丝的人，一眼就能认出黑子。
en: A fanboy knows a hater.

text: 银幕内外叠在一起，她演的角色终于替她说完遗言。
en: Screen and life stack together — the role finally speaks the last words she could not.

text: 人言可畏。
信仰不是靠奇迹活着的。
en: Faith does not live by miracles.

text: 人生可怕之处就在于：人人都有自己的理由。
en: The awful thing about life is this: everyone has their reasons.

text: 沿着海湾跑，不是为了赢，是为了不被原油废景吞掉。
en: Running along the gulf is not to win — it is not to be swallowed by the oil-stained waste.

text: 智者从敌人那里学到的，比傻瓜从朋友那里学到的更多。
en: A wise man can learn more from his enemies than a fool from his friends.

text: 身体残了，爱还可以重新长出来。
en: The body may break — love can still grow back.

text: 好好活下去。
en: Earn this.

text: 这个瑞恩最好值得——他最好回家去，治好某种疾病。
en: This Ryan better be worth it. He'd better go home and cure some disease.

text: 也许，一个人的牺牲能够拯救这个世界。
en: Perhaps one man’s sacrifice can save the world.

text: 我只想好起来。
en: I just want to get well.

text: 我爱你。我爱你。我爱你。
en: I love you. I love you. I really love you. I love you.

text: 别往下看！
en: Don't look down!

text: 人一旦死了——就死了。
en: When someone is dead, they are dead.

text: 刀可以放下，砧板前的人仍要立身。
en: You may lay down the sword — but at the cutting board, a person must still stand upright.

text: 这不是将军的家事，这是我们的人生。
en: This is not the lord’s family matter; it is our life.

text: 最好的刀，是留在刀鞘里的刀。
en: The best sword is the one that stays in its sheath.

text: 阿巴约——再见啦！
记忆不是过去，而是现在的另一种形态。
en: Memory is not the past, but another form of the present.

text: 没有慈悲，人就不成其为人。
en: Without mercy, man is not a human being.

text: 我们必须重新开始。
en: We have to start again.

text: 活下去，还是死去。做出你的选择。
en: Live or die. Make your choice.

text: 我想玩个游戏。
en: I want to play a game.

text: 大多数人对活着毫无感激——但你不会了。从今往后不会了。
en: Most people are so ungrateful to be alive. But not you. Not anymore.

text: 游戏结束。
en: Game over.

text: 你们这帮龟孙子想要打仗——是吗？来啊！……跟我的小朋友问个好！
en: Say hello to my little friend!

text: 先搞到钱，然后有权，然后有女人。
en: First you get the money, then you get the power, then you get the women.

text: 这世上我只有两样东西：我的胆量和我的信用——我谁都不背叛。
en: All I have in this world is my balls and my word, and I don't break them for no one.

text: 眼睛，奇科。眼睛从不撒谎。
en: The eyes, Chico. They never lie.

text: 听不见浪声，也能学会跟海相处。
en: Even without hearing the waves, you can still learn to live with the sea.

text: 我们至少曾经是朋友。
en: At least we used to be friends.

text: 他不会出卖任何人来换自己的前途。
en: He won't sell anybody out to buy his future!

text: 如果我还是五年前的我——我会拿喷火器把这地方烧了！
en: If I were the man I was five years ago, I'd take a FLAMETHROWER to this place!

text: 如今我走到人生的十字路口。我永远知道哪条路是对的——毫无例外，我都知道。但我从不走。你知道为什么吗？因为太难了。
en: Now I have come to the crossroads in my life. I always knew what the right path was. Without exception, I knew. But I never took it. You know why? It was too damn hard.

text: 凡救一命，即救全世界。
en: Whoever saves one life, saves the world entire.

text: 权力，是当我们有充分的理由去杀——而我们不杀。
en: Power is when we have every justification to kill, and we don't.

text: 这辆车——本可以再换十个人。这枚胸针——两个人。这是金子，两条命。
en: This car — Goeth would have bought this car. Why did I keep the car? Ten people right there... This pin. Two people. This is gold. Two more people.

text: 校园里没有退路。
en: There is no way back on campus.

text: 每到下雪，我就会想起他。
en: You can still see him when it snows.

text: 你看，他下来之前，这里从不下雪。他来了之后，就下了。
en: You see, before he came down here, it never snowed. And afterwards, it did.

text: 抱住我。
en: Hold me.

text: 我不能。
en: I can't.

text: 盒子里是什么？
en: What's in the box?

text: 海明威写过：世界是个好地方，值得为之奋斗。我同意后半句。
en: Ernest Hemingway once wrote, 'The world is a fine place and worth fighting for.' I agree with the second part.

text: 真希望我这一生，能活得稍微不同一点。
en: I wish I could have lived my life a little differently.

text: 就是那一天。
en: That’ll be the day.

text: 在别人家里，爱也要先学会规矩。
en: In someone else’s house, even love must first learn the rules.

text: 一盘couscous里，藏着一家人不肯散的理由。
en: In one plate of couscous lies a family's reason not to fall apart.

text: 你怎么能先原谅他？
en: How can you forgive him first?

text: 到底谁才是真的？
en: Who is the real one, after all?

text: 我想知道我来自哪里。
en: I want to know where I come from.

text: 他知道你是他儿子吗？——可我知道他是我父亲。
en: Does he know that you are his son? — But I know that he is my dad.

text: 荣誉不是挂在嘴上的东西。
en: Honor is not something you wear on your lips.

text: 上帝用七天创造了世界。而我，用七秒钟就摧毁了自己的世界。
en: In seven days, God created the world. And in seven seconds, I shattered mine.

text: 保护别人，才能保护自己。
en: By protecting others, you save yourselves.

text: 你这样——还配当武士吗！
又是我们输了。赢的，是农民。
我要的是知识——不是信仰，不是臆测，是知识。
en: I want knowledge! Not faith, not assumptions, but knowledge.

text: 白塔有光，人却无影。
en: The white pagoda has light, yet people cast no shadow.

text: 做倌人最难的，是遇着一个好客人。
en: The hardest thing about being a courtesan is finding a good client.

text: 你身上有红的。
en: You've got red on you.

text: 去温切斯特酒馆，来杯冰啤酒，等这一切自己过去。
en: Let's go down the Winchester, have a nice cold pint, and wait for all this to blow over.

text: 这份炸金片怎么样？
en: How's that for a slice of fried gold?

text: 希望是美好的，也许是人间至善，而美好的事物永不消逝。
en: Hope is a good thing, maybe the best of things, and no good thing ever dies.

text: 要么忙着活，要么忙着死。
en: Get busy living, or get busy dying.

text: 监狱里的高墙实在是很有趣。刚入狱的时候，你痛恨周围的高墙；慢慢地，你习惯了生活在其中；最终你会发现自己不得不依靠它而生存。这就叫体制化。
en: These walls are kind of funny. First you hate 'em, then you get used to 'em. Enough time passes, you get so you depend on them. That's institutionalized.

text: 听我说，朋友，希望是件危险的事，希望能叫人发疯。
en: Let me tell you something, my friend. Hope is a dangerous thing. Hope can drive a man insane.

text: 我希望我能越过边境，我希望见到我的朋友，和他握握手。我希望太平洋的海水如我梦中一样蓝。我希望。
en: I hope I can make it across the border. I hope to see my friend and shake his hand. I hope the Pacific is as blue as it has been in my dreams. I hope.

text: 如果现实不让我成为英雄，我就在电影里成为英雄。
en: If reality will not make me a hero, I will become one in the movies.

text: 星星啊，吉莉安！去问星星！
en: The stars, Gillian darling! Ask the stars!

text: 嗨——约翰尼！
en: Here's Johnny!

text: 只工作不玩耍，聪明的杰克也变傻。
en: All work and no play makes Jack a dull boy.

text: 我不会伤害你的——我只是要把你的脑袋砸烂。
en: I'm not gonna hurt you. I'm just going to bash your brains in.

text: 你无法想象。
en: You cannot imagine it.

text: 友谊在牢房里比在马背上更难骑稳。
en: Friendship is harder to keep steady in a cell than on horseback.

text: 我不想当英雄，我只想做个普通人。
en: I do not want to be a hero; I only want to be an ordinary man.

text: 血缘不是家庭的唯一答案。
en: Blood doesn't make a family—choice does.

text: 没有所谓好的死亡。
en: There is no such thing as a good death.

text: 我受够了这个鬼地方。
en: I’m so fucking sick of this place.

text: 从来没有人，是靠和别人一样，而改变世界的。
en: No one ever made a difference by being like everyone else.

text: 最高贵的艺术，是让别人快乐。
en: The noblest art is that of making others happy.

text: 怪物就像洋葱。
en: Ogres are like onions.

text: 憋着不如放出来——我一向这么说。
en: Better out than in, I always say.

text: 你认识松饼人吗？
en: Do you know the Muffin Man?

text: 哪种更糟：活成怪物，还是死成好人？
en: Which would be worse: to live as a monster, or to die as a good man?

text: 你在这里活不下去。你不是狼，而这里是狼的土地。
en: You will not survive here. You are not a wolf. And this is a land of wolves.

text: 徽章？我们不需要徽章！
en: Badges? We ain’t got no badges. We don’t need no badges!

text: 金子是个魔鬼。
en: Ah, gold is a very devil.

text: 我想交朋友。但首先，我得学会喜欢自己。
en: I want friends. But first, I have to learn to like myself.

text: 我在雨中歌唱——多么荣耀的感觉！
en: I'm singing in the rain, just singing in the rain! What a glorious feeling, I'm happy again!

text: 体面。永远要体面。
en: Dignity. Always dignity.

text: 我赚的钱比卡尔文·柯立芝还多——两个他加起来！
en: I make more money than Calvin Coolidge, put together!

text: 我看得见死人。
en: I see dead people.

text: 他们看不见彼此。他们只看见自己想看见的东西。他们不知道自己已经死了。
en: They don't see each other. They only see what they want to see. They don't know they're dead.

text: 外婆想让我告诉你，她看过你跳舞。她说你跳得像天使。
en: She wanted me to tell you she saw you dance. She said you danced like an angel.

text: 我给了你一张不会被烧毁的皮肤。
en: I gave you a skin that cannot be burned.

text: 有时候，老办法才是最好的办法。
en: Sometimes the old ways are the best.

text: 每个人都需要个爱好。——你的呢？——复活。
en: Everybody needs a hobby. ... So what's yours? ... Resurrection.

text: 一切都是写好的。
en: It is written.

text: 这是我们的命运。
en: It's our destiny.

text: 始终如一。
en: Always.

text: 你有一双和你母亲一样的眼睛。
en: You have your mother's eyes.

text: 你知道「复仇女神」是什么意思吗？由合适的代理人体现出来的、正义的报应。就眼下这情形，代理人是个可怕的混蛋：我。
en: Do you know what 'nemesis' means? A righteous infliction of retribution manifested by an appropriate agent. Personified in this case by an 'orrible cunt: me.

text: 皮肤很软，可秘密一旦戳破就再也收不回。
en: The skin is soft — but once a secret is pierced, it cannot be taken back.

text: 我们不要别的世界。我们要的是镜子。
en: We don't need other worlds. We need mirrors.

text: 人需要人。
en: Chelovek cheloveku nuzhen.

text: 没有人是完美的。
en: Well, nobody's perfect.

text: 我不能生孩子。
en: I can't have children.

text: 我们可以领养。
en: We'll adopt some.

text: 游戏结束了。
en: The game is over.

text: 愿坐下的人得蒙眷爱。
en: Beloved be the one who sits down.

text: 你的火花，并不是你的人生目标。
en: Your spark isn't your purpose.

text: 小鱼说：我想找到他们说的「海洋」。老鱼说：你现在就在海里啊。小鱼说：这就是水？我要的是海洋！
en: This little fish says, 'I want to know what water is.' The older fish says, 'This is water.'

text: 我要珍惜活着的每一分钟。
en: I'm going to live every minute of it.

text: 我听见了山的声音。
en: I heard the sound of the mountain.

text: 爬过每一座高山，涉过每一条溪流。
en: Climb every mountain, ford every stream.

text: 当主关上一扇门，祂一定会在某处打开一扇窗。
en: When the Lord closes a door, somewhere He opens a window.

text: 一切都会好起来的。
en: Everything's going to be okay.

text: 不。我要走自己的路。
en: Nah. Imma do my own thing.

text: 就这样——信仰之跃。
en: That's all it is, Miles. A leap of faith.

text: 谁都可以戴上面具——你也可以。以前你若不知道，现在希望你知道了。
en: Anyone can wear the mask. You can wear the mask. If you didn't know that before, I hope you do now.

text: 谁都可以戴上面具。你也可以。
en: Anyone can wear the mask. You can wear the mask.

text: 他不是怪物，他只是孤独。
en: He is not a monster; he is only lonely.

text: 曾经发生过的事不可能忘记，只不过是想不起来而已。
en: Once you've met someone you never really forget them.

text: 名字一旦被夺走，就再也找不到回家的路了。
从今往后，你的名字就叫小千。
千万不要回头。
如果说养大一个孩子需要一整个村子，那么虐待一个孩子，也需要一整个村子。
en: If it takes a village to raise a child, it takes a village to abuse one.

text: 我本不该回来，可我还是回来了。
en: I shouldn’t have come back, but I came back anyway.

text: 唱戏是一辈子的事。
en: Acting is a lifelong commitment.

text: 认认真真唱戏，清清白白做人。
柔软是伟大的，强硬一无是处。
en: Softness is great and strength is worthless.

text: 我再也没有交过像十二岁时那样的朋友——你是不是也这样？
en: I never had any friends later on like the ones I had when I was twelve. Jesus, does anyone?

text: 愿原力与你同在。
en: May the Force be with you.

text: 你要找的机器人不是这几个。
en: These aren't the droids you're looking for.

text: 我感到原力起了一阵巨大的扰动，仿佛千百万个声音同时惊呼，又骤然沉寂。
en: I felt a great disturbance in the Force, as if millions of voices suddenly cried out in terror and were suddenly silenced.

text: 我找人。
en: I'm looking for someone.

text: 人啊，还是得一步一步往前走。
en: People just have to keep walking, step by step.

text: 爱情像偷来的吻，甜，可总怕被发现。
en: Love is like stolen kisses — sweet, and always afraid of being caught.

text: 你可能会问自己：我是怎么来到这里的？
en: You may ask yourself, well, how did I get here?

text: 先生们，不能在这儿打架！这儿是作战室！
en: Gentlemen, you can't fight in here! This is the War Room!

text: 一种外来物质，混入了我们珍贵的体液……
en: A foreign substance is introduced into our precious bodily fluids...

text: 我的元首！我能走路了！
en: Mein Führer! I can walk!

text: 我再也不能坐视共产主义对我们珍珠般的体液的渗透……
en: I can no longer sit back and allow Communist infiltration... to sap and impurify all of our precious bodily fluids.

text: 我们的心都不柔软了，只知道自己的痛，不知道别人的痛。
en: Our hearts have hardened — we know only our own pain, not anyone else’s.

text: 枪丢了，酷暑里的东京就变成一张更大的网。
en: Once the gun is lost, Tokyo in the heat becomes a wider net.

text: 不管你是谁——我一向仰赖陌生人的善意。
en: Whoever you are—I have always depended on the kindness of strangers.

text: 斯特拉——！
en: STELLA!

text: 我不要什么真实，我要的是魔法！
en: I don't want realism. I want magic!

text: 有些事是不可原谅的——故意的残忍，不可原谅。
en: But some things are not forgivable. Deliberate cruelty is not forgivable.

text: 我们不该做朋友，你和我。我们本该是敌人。
en: We're not supposed to be friends, you and me. We're meant to be enemies.

text: 你是我最好的朋友，什穆埃尔——一辈子的那种。
en: You're my best friend, Shmuel. My best friend for life.

text: 成功的气味并不甜，它闻起来像别人的恐惧。
en: The smell of success is not sweet — it smells like someone else's fear.

text: 猫在袋子里，袋子在河里。
en: The cat's in the bag, and the bag's in the river.

text: 你就是一块灌满砒霜的饼干。
en: You're a cookie full of arsenic.

text: 教这样的人柔道，就像把刀交给疯子。
en: Teaching judo to such a man is like giving a knife to a lunatic.

text: 想拍苦难的人，有时最需要先学会让人笑。
en: Those who set out to film misery sometimes need first to learn how to make people laugh.

text: 大人的世界，小孩看不懂。
en: Children can't understand the adult world.

text: 八月一过，夏天就没了。
en: Once August ends, summer is gone.

text: 夏天海滨的犹豫，比告白本身更漫长。
en: On a summer shore, hesitation lasts longer than the confession itself.

text: 再大的网络，也大不过一家人同心。
en: No network is bigger than a family pulling together.

text: 我们曾是彼此的阳光。
en: We were each other's sunshine.

text: 我，以前真的很漂亮吧？
这是一首关于男人和女人的歌，它属于任何地方，也属于每个地方；你可能在任何时间、任何地点听见它。
en: This song of the Man and the Woman is of no place and every place; you might hear it anywhere at any time.

text: 好了，科长——我准备好拍特写了。
en: All right, Mr. DeMille, I'm ready for my close-up.

text: 我没有变小——是电影变小了。
en: I am big. It's the pictures that got small.

text: 我们那时不需要台词——我们有脸。
en: We didn't need dialogue. We had faces.

text: 杀了人，才能知道自己。
en: Only by killing do you know yourself.

text: 未来没有定式。除了我们自己创造的，没有命运。
en: The future is not set. There is no fate but what we make for ourselves.

text: 我现在知道你为什么哭了。但那是我永远做不到的事。
en: I know now why you cry. But it's something I can never do.

text: 如果一台机器都能学会人命的价值——也许我们也能。
en: If a machine, a Terminator, can learn the value of human life... maybe we can too.

text: 美，本身就是御法度。
en: Beauty itself is the taboo.

text: 要想抓小偷，就得把整个世界都抓起来。
en: If you want to arrest a thief, you'll have to arrest the world.

text: 对她说。把话告诉她。
en: Talk to her. Tell her that.

text: 一碗拉面的完美，比一场决斗更需要勇气。
en: The perfection of a bowl of ramen takes more courage than a duel.

text: 樱桃的滋味，值得你活下去。
en: The taste of a cherry is worth living for.

text: 你是在跟我说话吗？
en: You talkin' to me?

text: 孤独跟了我一辈子。酒吧、汽车、人行道、商店——无处不在。无处可逃。我是上帝的孤独之人。
en: Loneliness has followed me my whole life... There's no escape. I'm God's lonely man.

text: 我觉得该有人把这城市整个……冲下马桶。
en: I think someone should just take this city and just... flush it down the fuckin' toilet.

text: 我等。等到可以回家的那一天。
en: I wait. Until the day I can go home.

text: 我会回来的。
en: I'll be back.

text: 想活命就跟我来。
en: Come with me if you wanna live!

text: 我需要你的衣服、靴子和摩托车。
en: I need your clothes, your boots and your motorcycle.

text: 这不是直播事故，这是恐惧本身在直播。
en: This isn't a broadcast accident—fear itself is on the air.

text: 背起重担朝前走，自由大路快筑完。
en: Shoulder the load and march on — finish the road to freedom.

text: 你要学会做你自己；做到这一点，就什么都不用怕。
en: Learn to be yourself — once you can, you needn’t fear anything.

text: 把孩子卖掉的那一刻，你也把自己卖了。
en: The moment you sell the child, you sell yourself.

text: 教室的墙很薄，外面的世界随时会闯进来。
en: The classroom walls are thin — the outside world can break in at any moment.

text: 我想我能做到。
en: I believe I can do it.

text: 一个微笑，也许还有一滴眼泪。
en: A smile—and perhaps a tear.

text: 究竟谁才是癫的？
en: Who is the mad one, really?

text: 我不知道。
en: I don't know.

text: 你得有个噱头。
en: You gotta have a gimmick.

text: 你安于什么，就会得到什么。
en: You get what you settle for.

text: 有什么东西在我身体里变了。我回不去了。
en: Something's, like, crossed over in me. I can't go back.

text: 别被抓住。我们继续走。
en: Let's not get caught. Let's keep going.

text: 我喝你的奶昔！
en: I drink your milkshake!

text: 我心里有场比赛。我不许任何人成功。我恨大多数人。
en: I have a competition in me. I want no one else to succeed. I hate most people.

text: 我说过我会吃了你！
en: I told you I would eat you!

text: 是排水！这是排水问题！
en: Drainage! Drained dry, I'm so sorry.

text: 他教我叫他爸爸，却先偷走了我的童年。
en: He taught me to call him father — then stole my childhood first.

text: 我没有杀人。
en: I did not kill anybody.

text: 谁都不信谁——我们都累极了。
en: Nobody trusts anybody now, and we're all very tired.

text: 我知道我是人。如果你们中间谁已经是那东西——你现在就该扑上来。所以，你们中间还有人。
en: I know I'm human. And if you were all these things, then you'd just attack me right now. So some of you are still human.

text: 意大利在博吉亚家族治下三十年：战争、恐怖、谋杀、流血——却出了米开朗基罗、达·芬奇和文艺复兴。瑞士呢？兄弟之爱、五百年民主与和平——结果呢？咕咕钟。
en: In Italy for 30 years under the Borgias they had warfare, terror, murder, and bloodshed, but they produced Michelangelo, Leonardo da Vinci, and the Renaissance. In Switzerland they had brotherly love—they had 500 years of democracy and peace, and what did that produce? The cuckoo clock.

text: 我想做一个能够去爱的神父。
en: I want to be a priest who can love.

text: 阿斯加德不是一个地方，从来都不是。这里也可以是阿斯加德。阿斯加德，就是我们的子民所在之处。
en: Asgard is not a place. Never was. This could be Asgard. Asgard is where our people stand.

text: 我向你保证，哥哥——太阳会再次照耀我们。
en: I assure you, brother... the sun will shine on us again.

text: 把灭霸给我带来！
en: Bring me Thanos!

text: 兄弟可以一起闯祸，却很难一起长大。
en: Brothers can get into trouble together — growing up together is harder.

text: 现在我只有一件事可做：什么也不做。
en: Now I have only one thing to do: nothing.

text: 平等若只剩报复，白光也会冷得像雪。
en: If equality shrinks to revenge, even white light turns as cold as snow.

text: 最好的时光，总在回望里。
en: The best of times live in looking back.

text: 蜘蛛的巢穴很难逃脱。
en: The spider’s web is hard to escape.

text: 上帝就是爱，而爱就是上帝。
en: God is love, and love is God.

text: 天书的本事，要传给能造福于百姓的人。
en: The power of the heavenly book must go to those who can benefit the people.

text: 天道无私。既有天书，理当传授于人。
我应该和组织保持步调一致，但我不能对党说假话。
en: I should keep in step with the organization — but I cannot lie to the Party.

text: 占领可以改规矩，改不了人要有尊严地活。
en: Occupation can rewrite the rules — not a person's need to live with dignity.

text: 家园还在日历上，日子却一天天被改写。
en: Home remains on the calendar, while each day is rewritten.

text: 我决定不再长大。
en: I decided not to grow up.

text: 身体可以长出金属，爱却还得用人的样子去求。
en: The body can grow metal — love still has to beg in a human shape.

text: 你跳，我也跳。
en: You jump, I jump.

text: 你必须答应我——答应我你会活下去。
en: You must do me this honor. Promise me you'll survive.

text: 赢到那张船票，是我一生最幸运的事——它让我遇见了你。
en: Winning that ticket was the best thing that ever happened to me... it brought me to you.

text: 我永不放手，杰克。永不。
en: I'll never let go, Jack. I'll never let go.

text: 他对莎士比亚做了什么，我们正在对波兰做什么。
en: What he did to Shakespeare, we are now doing to Poland.

text: 我们负责集中，波兰人负责营。
en: We do the concentrating, and the Poles do the camping.

text: 人是为活着本身而活着，而不是为了活着之外的任何事物而活着。
en: A person lives for the sake of living itself, not for anything beyond that.

text: 小鸡长大了就变成鹅，鹅长大了就变成羊，羊长大了就变成牛——牛以后，日子就越来越好了。
跳过时间并不难，难的是跳回去以后还想不想承认。
en: Leaping through time is easy; the hard part is whether you still want to admit it after you land.

text: 我走自己的路。
en: I walk my own path.

text: 奇迹总会发生在被遗弃的人身上。
en: Miracles happen to the abandoned, too—especially on Christmas.

text: 外面的世界塌了，家里的琴声还得继续。
en: When the outside world collapses, the piano at home still has to go on.

text: 人一寂寞，就会变坏。
en: When people get lonely, they go bad.

text: 这个夏天，我想用另一个名字做自己。
en: This summer, I want to be myself under another name.

text: 关键不在飞机，而在飞行员。
en: It’s not the plane, it’s the pilot.

text: 别想——就去做。
en: Don't think, just do.

text: 来，大家笑一个。一笑，什么可怕的事都会过去。
en: Everybody, try laughing. Then whatever scares you will go away!

text: 我看到龙猫了！
能见到龙猫，小梅真是个幸运的孩子。
你的未来已经用光了。
en: Your future is all used up.

text: 他是个了不起的人——我是说，他算个人物。
en: He was some kind of a man.

text: 无欲，便无所畏惧。
en: Without desire, there is nothing to fear.

text: 人被逼急了，什么都做得出来。
en: When people are driven to the edge, they can do anything.

text: 我们要离开这里，去巴黎。
en: We are going to leave here, for Paris.

text: 飞向宇宙，浩瀚无垠！
en: To infinity and beyond!

text: 把手举向天空！
en: Reach for the sky!

text: 我靴子里有蛇！
en: There's a snake in my boot!

text: 这不是飞——这是有风格的坠落。
en: This isn't flying. This is falling with style.

text: 你是个又可悲又古怪的小人儿，我为你感到遗憾。
en: You are a sad, strange little man, and you have my pity.

text: 再见了，伙伴。
en: So long, partner.

text: 我们都只是等着被扔掉的垃圾！玩具就是这么回事。
en: We're all just trash waitin' to be thrown away! That's all a toy is!

text: 胡迪……他是我从小到大的伙伴。胡迪最特别的地方，是他永远不会放弃你——永远。
en: Now Woody... he's been my pal for as long as I can remember... But the thing that makes Woody special is he'll never give up on you... ever.

text: 金刚跟我比都算不了什么！
en: King Kong ain't got shit on me!

text: 重要的不是你知道什么——而是你能证明什么。
en: It's not what you know, it's what you can prove.

text: 这是下棋，不是跳棋。
en: The shit is chess, it ain't checkers.

text: 选择生活。选择工作。选择职业。选择家庭。
en: Choose life. Choose a job. Choose a career. Choose a family.

text: 我选择不选择生活——我选择了别的什么。
en: I chose not to choose life. I chose something else.

text: 你以为你在逃，其实你只是又绕回了起点。
en: You think you're escaping—you're only looping back to the start.

text: 千王之王，骗的不是局，是人心里愿意信的那一下。
en: The king of swindlers does not cheat the game — he cheats the moment you want to believe.

text: 你以为你可以审判别人吗？
en: Do you think you can judge others?

text: 如果再也见不到你，祝你早安，午安，晚安。
en: In case I don't see you… good afternoon, good evening, and good night.

text: 我们都会接受摆在眼前的世界——就这么简单。
en: We accept the reality of the world with which we're presented. It's as simple as that.

text: 你们从来就没在我脑子里装过摄影机！
en: You never had a camera in my head!

text: 外面的世界和我造给你的世界一样没多少真话。但在我的世界里，你什么都不用怕。
en: There's no more truth out there than in the world I created for you... but in my world, you have nothing to fear.

text: 地雷区的孩子仰望卫星天线，像在等一个不会落地的消息。
en: Children in a minefield look up at a satellite dish, waiting for news that will never land.

text: 我不想只是活下来。我想要生活。
en: I don't want to survive. I want to live.

text: 我叫所罗门·诺瑟普——我是个自由人。
en: My name is Solomon Northup. I am a free man.

text: 请不要为了我丢掉自己的奖金——可我还是想求你投我一票。
en: Please don't lose your bonus for me — and still, I ask you to vote for me.

text: 这世上终究还是有美好的事物，佛罗多先生，值得我们奋战到底。
en: There's some good in this world, Mr. Frodo. And it's worth fighting for.

text: 就像那些伟大的故事里写的一样，佛罗多先生——那些真正重要的故事。
en: It's like in the great stories, Mr. Frodo. The ones that really mattered.

text: 每个孩子都有自己的长处，有自己的能力，有自己的渴望。
en: Har bachche ki apni khoobi hoti hai, apni kaabiliyat hoti hai, apni chahat hoti hai.

text: 壶里烧出的不是陶器，是贪心的形状。
en: What the kiln fires is not pottery — it is the shape of greed.

text: 就算被吃掉，我也想和你在一起。
en: Even if I get eaten, I still want to be with you.

text: 哪怕只剩一条狗，人也要活得像个人。
en: Even with only a dog left, a man must still live like a man.

text: 跟「应得」没关系。
en: Deserve's got nothing to do with it.

text: 杀人真是件可怕的事。你夺走他的全部——也夺走他今后的一切。
en: It's a hell of a thing, killing a man. You take away all he's got, and all he's ever gonna have.

text: 冒险就在外面！
en: Adventure is out there!

text: 我才刚见到你，就爱上你了。
en: I have just met you, and I love you.

text: 松鼠！
en: Squirrel!

text: 魔鬼拉取的最大骗局——就是让世界相信他并不存在。
en: The greatest trick the Devil ever pulled was convincing the world he didn't exist.

text: 就这样……他消失了。
en: And like that... he's gone.

text: 摄影已经完了。
en: Photography is finished.

text: 人民不应该害怕政府，政府应该害怕人民。
en: People should not be afraid of their government. Governments should be afraid of their people.

text: 面具之下不只有血肉。面具之下是思想，克里迪先生——而思想，是杀不死的。
en: Beneath this mask there is more than flesh. Beneath this mask there is an idea, Mr. Creedy — and ideas are bulletproof.

text: 上帝在雨里。
en: God is in the rain.

text: 瞧！眼前是一位谦逊的杂耍老手……
en: Voilà! In view, a humble vaudevillian veteran...

text: 我不要屋顶，也不要法律。
en: I want no roof and no law.

text: 我不知道自己是谁。
en: I don’t know who I am.

text: 她需要血。必须是人血。你愿意献出自己的血吗？
en: But she needs blood. It must be human blood. Are you willing to give her your own?

text: 这个世界上没有神。
en: There is no God in this world.

text: 明星的光晕褪尽之后，吗啡比镜头更听话。
en: After a star's halo fades, morphine obeys better than the camera.

text: 两个生命共用一串音符时，谁先停下来，谁就成了回声。
en: When two lives share one melody, whoever stops first becomes the echo.

text: 你是我的第二次机会。
en: You're my second chance, Judy.

text: 一个人是流浪——两个人在一起，总是要去某个地方。
en: Only one is a wanderer; two together are always going somewhere.

text: 上帝，请宽恕我。
en: God, forgive me.

text: 圣徒把餐桌让给穷人之后，筵席会变成另一场审判。
en: After the saint yields her table to the poor, the feast becomes another kind of judgment.

text: 生活被一句话一句话说完之前，人已经不在场了。
en: Before life is finished being spoken sentence by sentence, the person has already left the room.

text: 为什么非得说话呢？
en: Pourquoi faut-il parler?

text: 那就该在春天下雪。
en: Then I guess it should snow in spring.

text: 幸福若在对岸，港口就只会一直等人上船。
en: If happiness is across the water, the port will only keep waiting for someone to board.

text: 我不想只是活着，我想要生活。
en: I don't want to survive. I want to live.

text: 伊——娃！
en: Ee-vah!

text: 贪婪——找不到更好的词——是好的。
en: Greed, for lack of a better word, is good.

text: 午餐是给懦夫准备的。
en: Lunch is for wimps.

text: 你不在里面，就在外面！
en: If you're not inside, you're outside!

text: 你在努力？就现在？当初要紧的时候你人在哪儿？我小时候需要这个人。现在不需要你了。太迟了。一切都已经发生了。
en: You're trying? Now? Where were you when it mattered? I needed this guy back when I was a kid. I don't need you now. It's too late now. Everything's already happened.

text: 罗曼蒂克，总要消亡。
en: Romance, sooner or later, perishes.

text: 我本可以是个竞争者——我本可以是个人物——而不是像现在这样，只是个废物。
en: I coulda had class. I coulda been a contender. I coulda been somebody, instead of a bum, which is what I am.

text: 你站在哪一边？
en: Which side are you on?

text: 把这好运符带着——等战争结束，再还给我。
en: Keep this good-luck charm—and give it back to me when the war is over.

text: 我爱过你，除了你，我谁也没爱过。
en: I loved you, I've never loved anyone else. I never shall.

text: 没事的，会放晴的。
en: It's okay — it'll clear up.

text: 天气什么的，就这样乱下去好了！
有些真相，看在眼里就够了，不必说出口。
en: Some truths are enough seen with the eyes—they need not be spoken.

text: 这不是小说，这是电影。电影就是生活。
en: This isn't a novel, it's a film. A film is life.

text: 你是太阳。太阳不动——是地球在转。
en: You are the sun. The sun doesn't move—this is what it does.

text: 英语里最害人的两个词，就是「干得不错」。
en: There are no two words in the English language more harmful than "good job".

text: 我在场是为了把人推到他们想象的极限之外——我相信这是绝对必要的。
en: I was there to push people beyond what's expected of them. I believe that is an absolute necessity.

text: 差一点——不是我的节奏。
en: Not quite my tempo.

text: 查理·帕克在乔·琼斯往他脑袋上砸镲片之前，也没人认识他。
en: Charlie Parker didn't know anybody till Jo Jones threw a cymbal at his head.

text: 我想写一个属于自己的故事。
en: I want to write a story that is truly my own.

text: 你不再是个野人了，即便你还不是个成人。
en: You're no longer a savage, even if you're not yet a man.

text: 我想起了童年，也想起了我曾经是个孩子。
en: I remember my childhood, and that I was once a child.

text: 野蛮，往往是文明人被逼到墙角后的选择。
en: Savagery is what civilized people choose when they're backed into a corner.

text: 风会把我们带走。
en: The wind will carry us.

text: 风起了，唯有努力生存。
en: The wind is rising! We must try to live.

text: 飞机，是美丽而被诅咒的梦。
现在我知道了天使不知道的事。
en: Now I know what no angel knows.

text: 上帝的沉默，比死亡更可怕。
en: God’s silence is more frightening than death.

text: 丢了的信未必会回来，但冬天适合把信念再诵一遍。
en: A lost letter may never return, but winter is a season for repeating one's faith.

text: 我们是误打误撞来度假的。
en: We have gone on holiday by mistake.

text: 我觉得像有头猪在我脑袋里拉了屎。
en: I feel like a pig shat in my head.

text: 我妻子从不会说谎。
en: My wife never lies.

text: 没有什么地方比得上家。
en: There's no place like home.

text: 亲爱的，力量一直在你身上——从来都在。
en: You've always had the power, my dear. You've had it all along.

text: 有些没有脑子的人，话可真多，对吧？
en: Some people without brains do an awful lot of talking, don't they?

text: 我现在知道我有心了——因为它正在碎。
en: Now I know I've got a heart, because it's breaking.

text: 想做人就做人，想做狼就做狼。你们自己选。
en: Live as humans, or live as wolves. You choose.

text: 把这支笔卖给我。
en: Sell me this pen.

text: 听着——贫穷没有任何高贵可言。
en: Let me tell you something. There's no nobility in poverty.

text: 庞氏，庞氏……那是幻象，是仙尘。
en: Fugazi, fugazi... It's a wazi, it's a woozie. It's fairy dust.

text: 我要你用变富的方式来解决你的问题！
en: I want you to deal with your problems by becoming rich!

text: 我想有一间自己的店。
en: I want a place of my own.

text: 逃走，有时只是去见一个想见面的人。
en: To run away is sometimes only to go see someone you want to see.

text: 女人心，海底针。
en: A woman’s heart is a needle at the bottom of the sea.

text: 若必须在正确与善良之间二选一——请选择善良。
en: When given the choice between being right or being kind, choose kind.

text: 世界上每个人都应该至少获得一次起立鼓掌。
en: Everyone in the world should get a standing ovation at least once in their life.

text: 记住，乔治——没有一个拥有朋友的人，会是失败者。
en: Remember, George: no man is a failure who has friends.

text: 你得到了一份大礼，乔治——看一看，没有你的世界是什么样子。
en: You've been given a great gift, George: a chance to see what the world would be like without you.

text: 圣诞快乐，电影院！圣诞快乐，商铺！圣诞快乐，你这美妙的老建房互助会！
en: Merry Christmas, movie house! Merry Christmas, emporium! Merry Christmas, you wonderful old Building and Loan!

text: 爸爸你看，老师说每次铃铛响起来，就有一个天使得到了翅膀。
en: Look, Daddy. Teacher says every time a bell rings, an angel gets his wings.

text: 偶尔一点荒唐，连最聪明的人也津津有味。
en: A little nonsense now and then is relished by the wisest men.

text: 别忘了那个突然得到自己想要的一切的人的下场——他从此幸福地生活下去了。
en: Don't forget what happened to the man who suddenly got everything he always wanted... He lived happily ever after.

text: 拿全世界所有的巧克力来换，我也不换我的家人。
en: I wouldn't give up my family for anything. Not for all the chocolate in the world.

text: 糖果不需要什么意义——这正是它成为糖果的原因。
en: Candy doesn't need a point. That's why it's candy.

text: 生活总要继续。
en: Life has to go on.

text: 人可以倒下，账不能烂在心里。
en: A man may fall, but the debt must not rot in the heart.

text: 人穷志不能短。
萧萧的命，是别人给的。
en: Xiaoxiao’s fate was handed to her by others.

text: 今晚月黑风高，正是杀人放火的好天气。
en: A moonless, windy night—perfect weather for murder and arson.

text: 海的那边没有活路，海的这边也没有。
en: There is no way to live on that side of the sea — and none on this side either.

text: 昨天、今天、明天——女人用身体换来的，往往只是活下去。
en: Yesterday, today, tomorrow — what a woman bargains with her body is often just survival.

text: 活了！它活了！它活了！
en: Alive! It's alive! It's ALIVE!

text: 本来会更糟——可能正在下雨呢。
en: Could be worse. Could be raining.

text: 像我这样走。
en: Walk this way.

text: 电影发明以后，人类的生命延长了三倍。
en: Movies give us three times as much life.

text: 爸比，你看不到，所以我拍给你看。
再活一次的话，好像……真的没有必要。
爸比，我们是不是只能知道一半的事情？我只能看到前面，看不到后面。
最好的刀，是留在刀鞘里的刀。
en: The best sword is the one that stays in its sheath.

text: 温和到不像这个时代的人，反而把时代照得更清楚。
en: Someone too gentle for his time ends up lighting that time more clearly.

text: 有人教你一条窄路，走出门才知道世界比路宽。
en: Someone teaches you a narrow path — only outdoors do you learn the world is wider.

text: 我敢说出我喜欢谁，你敢不敢？
en: I dare say who I like — do you?

text: 我想要见你。不管你在哪里，我都会去见你。
en: I want to see you. Wherever you are, I'll go to see you.

text: 重要的人。不能忘记的人。不想忘记的人。是谁？是谁？是谁？
只要相见——一定立刻就会明白。
一个始终不被善待的人，最能识别善良，也最珍惜善良。
en: Someone never treated kindly recognizes kindness best — and treasures it most.

text: 最难的不是老去，是学会对过去的旋律保持沉默。
en: The hardest part is not growing old — it is learning to stay silent before the melodies of the past.

text: 他们以后再也不会见面了。
en: They will never meet again.

text: 他不是意外死亡的。
en: He did not die by accident.

text: 就算眼睛睁得再大，我也看不见什么——可我听得见。
en: Even with eyes wide open I see little — but I can hear.

text: 在动物城，任何人都可以成为想成为的人。
en: In Zootopia, anyone can be anything.

text: 永远别让他们看到——他们伤到了你。
en: Never let them see that they get to you.

text: 你知道你爱我。
en: You know you love me.

text: 知道吗？——知道。
en: Do I know that? Yes. Yes, I do.
